anime.description: Keroro is a frog-like alien from planet Keron, who`s on a mission to conquer Pekopon (Earth). However, when his cover is blown, his battalion abandons him and he ends up in the home of the Hinata family. There, he`s forced to do household chores and sleep in a dark basement that was once a prison cell haunted by the ghost of an innocent girl. Keroro and his other 4 squad members continue with their plans to conquer Pekopon, aside from building Gundam Models and being lazy in various other ways... tag.name: shounen
tag.description: In the context of manga and associated media, shounen, literally meaning "youth" and often also specifically "boy", refers to a male audience roughly between the ages of 10 and 18. Source: Wikipedia

tag.name: alien
tag.description: This entity or creature was born on another world than the main characters.

tag.name: robot
tag.description: A robot is an automatically guided machine, able to do tasks on its own. Another common characteristic is that by its appearance or movements, a robot often conveys a sense that it has intent or agency of its own. Not to be confused with android (human-like robot).

tag.name: dynamic
tag.description: Some of the central structural elements in anime are: Plot Continuity How does the plot or several plots unfold. Are they a strictly linear retelling of one big continuing story, a serial, possibly with several side stories, or is the content chopped into a set of unconnected episodes, only sharing the same setting and characters? Stereotype Characters Then there is the question of the character set presentation. Is it completely original, or is it your usual stereotypical character cast. Both choices have their merit, for example it would not really make much sense to reinvent the wheel for a harem anime. Fans of that genre come to expect their favourite stereotype protagonists. Plot Twists Finally there is the question of how complex the plot / the story unfolds. Are there side-plots that merge into the main plot leading to unexpected plot twists, or is the anime quite predictable? The latter would not be appropriate for detective stories. In harem anime on the other hand a foreseeable outcome is actually something the fans will come to expect.

tag.name: target audience
tag.description: Anime, like everything else in the modern world, is targeted towards specific audiences, both implicitly by the creators and overtly by the marketing. While categories are associated with specific sex and age groups, this is not a bar on the anime being enjoyed by people who don`t fit into that band; not only do crossover titles exist, but the categories also have a considerable following outside their main demographic, and a person might as well enjoy anime from all categories. Still, does not invalidate the usefulness of marking a title as one of the categories; the same themes will likely be treated differently in anime geared for different audiences. Only one should not jump the gun and assume that a title will be more or less serious or present content in this or that way due to its target audience, or conversely assume the target audience on the content and its presentation alone. As such, the audience categories help form a broad impression of how a title might work with the announced themes, but offer little to no in-depth information about specific content or its treatment. The audience categories originate from manga magazines, which group titles of a same intended audience into a magazine that is advertised as belonging to that category, and so manga-based anime will have the category from their parent work. As for anime based on other works, the audience is often debatable, but comparing information such as time slot to the manga-based anime generally helps figure out the most likely possibility. If the parent material was classified under multiple audiences over time (for example, it was originally shounen, but then as the plot changed and became more mature, it was reclassified as seinen), and the anime adapts parent material time periods covering multiple audiences, we tag all audiences covered by the anime adaptation.

tag.name: themes
tag.description: Themes describe the very central elements important to the anime stories. They set the backdrop against which the protagonists must face their challenges. Be it School Life, present Daily Life, Military action, Cyberpunk, Law and Order detective work, Sports, or the Underworld. These are only but a few of the more typical backgrounds for anime plots. Add to that a Conspiracy setting with a possible tragic outcome, the Themes span most of the imaginable subject matter relevant to anime.

tag.name: original work
tag.description: What the anime is based on! This is given as the original work credit in the OP. Mostly of academic interest, but a useful bit of info, hinting at the possible depth of story.

tag.name: setting
tag.description: The setting describes in what time and place an anime takes place. To a certain extent it describes what you can expect from the world in the anime.

tag.name: elements
tag.description: Next to Themes setting the backdrop for the protagonists in anime, there are the more detailed plot Elements that centre on character interactions: "What do characters do to each other or what is done to them?". Is it violent Action, an awe-inspiring Adventure in a foreign place, the gripping life of a Detective, a slapstick Comedy, an Ecchi Harem anime, a SciFi epic, or some Fantasy travelling adventure?

tag.name: time
tag.description: This placeholder lists different epochs in human history and more vague but important timelines such as the future, the present and the past.

tag.name: place
tag.description: The places the anime can take place in. Includes more specific places such as a country on Earth, as well as more general places such as a dystopia or a mirror world.

tag.name: present
tag.description: Somewhere between past and future.

tag.name: space
tag.description: The final frontier.

tag.name: Earth
tag.description: The Earth is the third planet from the Sun, and the densest and fifth-largest of the eight planets in the Solar System. It is in effect a ball of hot mud, but on the surface it`s cold enough, so most of us live on it (or are supposed to). It is circa 4.5 billion years old, and, unless we humans succeed in destroying it over the next couple of centuries, it is expected to last for quite another while, though the changes in the Sun`s emissions due to its aging will likely cause the extinction of everything; the species of earthlings are guaranteed to die, even if we fail to kill them -- unless, of course, we find ourselves another planet and figure out a way to take everything there. Our little planet on a corner of this galaxy may mean nothing in the grand scheme of things, but to its inhabitants it is their home, so, as a species, we cherish it dearly, to the point many cultures even to this day deify it. Being the home to the human civilizations, the Earth is the main setting of most fiction, be it anime or otherwise, but not only are many titles set in other places, such as unrelated fantasy worlds, in a considerable number of fictional titles the Earth is actually destroyed by aggressive alien invaders.

tag.name: mecha
tag.description: Mecha in Japanese basically means mechanical things; everything from an electric whisk or a car to a spaceship or a robot. Here however we limit it to the more exotic things usually referred to as mecha anime: robots, whether controlled by a human or not, and their ilk. See Androids, Piloted Robots, Power Suits, Robot Helpers, Transforming Robots for a more specific classification.

tag.name: piloted robot
tag.description: Piloted Robots are, as the name suggests, robots that cannot control themselves; they need to be steered from somewhere, this can be from a human sitting inside or a remote controlled option.

tag.name: slapstick
tag.description: Slapstick humour is generally recognized by lots of physical abuse, horseplay and practical jokes. Also often seen are impossible situations, using sounds to illustrate impossible stunts that aren`t shown on-screen and to create tension for audience anticipation.

tag.name: medium awareness
tag.description: Medium awareness is the situational and generally temporary awareness characters in works of fiction have and display of the very fact that they are characters in works of fiction. For example, they may comment about the background music, quip about the script or narration, complain about the roles given to them by the writer or their lack of screen time, see the subtitles that appear on screen, inform the audience about the arrival of the commercial break, and even use medium effects as tools. The most common form of medium awareness is known as breaking the fourth wall, in which characters speak directly to the audience, either to it as a whole or to specific members of it. The "fourth wall" is the imaginary "wall" at the front of the stage of a proscenium theatre through which the audience sees the play; it is a metaphor for the boundary between what happens inside the work, to the characters, and outside it, to the audience.

tag.name: parody
tag.description: Anime that imitate other stories (can be from TV, film, books, historical events, ...) for comic effect by exaggerating the style and changing the content of the original. Also known as spoofs. It can also refer to when whole elements of one work are lifted out of their context and reused.

tag.name: Japan
tag.description: Japan is a sovereign island nation in East Asia. Located in the Pacific Ocean, it lies off the eastern coast of the Asian mainland and stretches from the Sea of Okhotsk in the north to the East China Sea and China in the southwest. Source: Wikipedia

tag.name: manga
tag.description: Manga is the lifeblood that drives the anime industry. Everything and its mother is based on manga. However! There are exceptions where the manga was not the basis for the anime. It`s common practice to make manga adaptations of many popular anime, there`s a manga based on Evangelion, and two (one shounen and one shoujo) based on each of Escaflowne and Mahou Tsukai Tai. Also it`s quite common to release manga and anime versions of a story in parallel, for instance Nadesico and Shoujo Kakumei Utena. There are also cases where an anime continues in a manga, as in the case of Angel Beats! and Angel Beats: Heaven`s Door, or reverse. See also http://anidb.net/t6493 [manhua] and http://anidb.net/t5010 [manhwa].

tag.name: Asia
tag.description: Asia is Earth`s largest and most populous continent, located primarily in the eastern and northern hemispheres and sharing the continental landmass of Eurasia with the continent of Europe. Asia covers an area of 44,579,000 square kilometers, about 30% of Earth`s total land area and 8.7% of the Earth`s total surface area. The continent, which has long been home to the majority of the human population, was the site of many of the first civilizations. Asia is notable for not only its overall large size and population, but also dense and large settlements as well as vast barely populated regions within the continent of 4.4 billion people. Source: Wikipedia

tag.name: science fiction
tag.description: Science fiction stories usually focus on how situations could be different in the future when we are more technologically advanced; due to either our own achievements or having met with other civilizations whom we have learned from.

tag.name: comedy
tag.description: Anime whose central struggle causes hilarious results. These stories are built upon funny characters, situations and events. A comedy anime is laced with humour and sets out to provoke laughter from the audience. Japanese humour can be a bit strange to westerners, so if you`re new to this type of humour, just bear with it; it`ll most likely grow on you if you`re a fan of other kinds of comedy.

tag.name: world domination
tag.description: "Gee, Brain, what do you want to do tonight?" "The same thing we do every night, Pinky: try to take over the world!" A main objective for one of the characters is absolute control of not just one country, but a whole planet!

tag.name: tanabata
tag.description: Tanabata (七夕, meaning "Evening of the seventh") is a Japanese star festival, originating from the Chinese Qixi Festival. It celebrates the meeting of the deities Orihime and Hikoboshi (represented by the stars Vega and Altair respectively). According to legend, the Milky Way separates these lovers, and they are allowed to meet only once a year on the seventh day of the seventh lunar month of the lunisolar calendar. The date of Tanabata varies by region of the country, but the first festivities begin on July 7 of the Gregorian calendar. The celebration is held at various days between July and August. (Source: Wikipedia)

tag.name: antihero
tag.description: An antihero is a main character in a story who lacks conventional heroic qualities and attributes such as idealism, courage and morality. Although antiheroes may sometimes perform actions that are morally correct, it is not always for the right reasons, often acting primarily out of self-interest or in ways that defy conventional ethical codes. A villain protagonist is where the leading character of the story (the protagonist) is also a villain; this is a fairly rare occurrence.

tag.name: rivalry
tag.description: Quite broadly used term describing a conflict, contest, struggle, or opposition of some sort. Typical examples: The mostly comedic rivalry for the love of a protagonist in a harem anime (love polygon), the more "mindless" battles between wannabe delinquents in a school fighting anime, or the struggle between good & evil in an epic conflict for world domination.

tag.name: show within a show
tag.description: A fictional TV (or radio, or stage) show that takes place within an actual TV show; or, occasionally, a fictional instalment or incarnation of an actual show. Many comedies have short one-off gags where they parody existing shows. Example: A large part of Martian Successor Nadesico is centred around the fictional popular anime Gekigangar III, which is being watched by several characters of the Nadesico crew.

tag.name: Tokyo is the centre of the universe
tag.description: Whether it`s the big bad evil aiming for world domination, demons bringing the hell over to this site or aliens attacking the Earth, their centre of attention is always Tokyo, as if the rest of the world did not even exist! But worry not if you happen to live there, because your neighbour could just be the leader of a senshi team or the pilot of a giant mecha and they are surely going to save the day again.

tag.name: brainwashing
tag.description: Brainwashing, the application of coercive techniques to change the values and beliefs, perceptions and judgements, and subsequent mindsets and behaviours of one or more people, usually for political, financial, personal, or religious purposes. The victim is left http://anidb.net/t91 [brainwashed]. Often featured in dark anime or pornography.

tag.name: mundane made awesome
tag.description: Sometimes normal just doesn`t cut it. Eating: you put food in your mouth and chew. Playing sports: you throw a ball around. You need to make it awesome, no matter how mundane it is. Let`s throw in some gripping orchestral music, lighting changes, different camera angles, something! Don`t write like a man, write like an evil overlord! Exaggerate your expressions and gestures, speak with excessive intonation, and if all else fails, throw in some close-ups, slow motion, and ominous Latin chanting! With practice, even you can turn something like eating chips into an epic battle of light and dark, blinding the viewer with sheer awesomeness. [Source: TV Tropes]

tag.name: tropes
tag.description: A trope is a commonly recurring literary and rhetorical devices, motifs or clichés in creative works. tag.name: speculative fiction
tag.description: Speculative fiction is an umbrella genre encompassing fiction with certain elements that do not exist in the real world, often in the context of supernatural, futuristic or other imaginative themes. This includes, but is not limited to, science fiction, fantasy, superhero fiction, horror, utopian and dystopian fiction, fairytale fantasy, supernatural fiction, as well as combinations thereof. Source: Wikipedia

character.name: Hinata Aki
character.description: Aki Hinata, is the single mother of Fuyuki and Natsumi Hinata and is the head of the family that Keroro lives with. Her exact age is unknown; however, she is believed to be around 35 years old. Whether it is supporting a family of three on her own, or making late night runs to the printing press on her trusty motorcycle, or kicking aliens around every few weeks, it is common belief (at least to the Keronians) that Hinata Aki is the strongest woman on Earth. Despite her fear of animals, she feels as though the Keroro Platoon is her own family (due entirely to them being shiny and possibly slimy, as opposed to the furry nature of most animals). As a chief manga editor/designer, she finds the aliens` lifestyle very interesting and often has spells of obsession over them. While Aki has no official Keronian partner (as none of the adults do), it is Kururu who has taken a special interest in her, to the extent of setting up a spy camera in her shower. Whether this is for the purposes of studying `the most powerful human on Earth` or for the same reasons anyone would spy on her in the shower remains to be seen.

character.name: RX-78-2 Gundam
character.description: The Gundam is one of three prototype mobile suits secretly developed by the embattled Earth Federation. After suffering tremendous losses to Zeon`s mobile suits earlier in the war, the Federation set out to create its own, using the very latest advanced technology. The Gundam is the most successful of these prototypes, a close-combat mobile suit protected by tough Luna Titanium armour, and armed with both lethal beam sabers and a devastating beam rifle as powerful as a battleship cannon. It`s also equipped with an advanced computer which learns from its pilot, ultimately enabling it to operate the Gundam automatically. In the hands of accidental pilot Amuro Ray, this one prototype mobile suit proves to be the equal of any Zeon weapon.

character.name: Giroro Gochou
character.description: Giroro is the single unit mobile infantry of the Keroro Platoon. He is a red Keronian who has a scar over his left eye. His symbol is a skull which, unlike the other Keronians, is only on his hat. In lieu of a belly symbol, he diagonally straps across his body a belt with a rectangular buckle. It is revealed that it contains a picture of Natsumi Hinata. The belt is priceless since it serves both as his good luck charm and as a reminder of his friends who died in a Keron War. Without it, he loses most of his abilities and is utterly inept as a soldier. However, as a young Keronian, he carried his skull symbol on his hat and belly and was not afflicted with the scar across his face. His often irritably short tempered self is caused by the unfocused members of the Platoon, especially Keroro, in their invasion of Pekopon. This often leads Giroro to physically assault Keroro by all means, including shoving a grenade in his mouth. Occasionally, his anger (usually triggered when defending Natsumi) drives him into "combat mode"— where most of his intelligence is converted into battle power and he only speaks in short sentences. He is in love with Natsumi and he almost always turns into a lovesick puppy around her. He lives just outside the Hinata house, slightly under Natsumi`s window. In the past, he was a typical Keronian who trained with Keroro and Zeroro so one day he could be just like his idolized brother. Giroro seldom wears a tailed white tuxedo, ruffled shirt, and either a black or pink bow tie, accompanied by a long, blond wig which he curls up in an old-fashioned way, to impress Natsumi.

character.name: Hinata Natsumi
character.description: The older sister of Fuyuki Hinata, Natsumi is a vivacious and fiery teenager whose most notable points are her great athletic prowess and her bitter rivalry with the series` antihero, Sergeant Keroro. As her mother, Aki, is mostly at work, Natsumi often takes care of the house chores, although she leaves most of them to Keroro, whom she always calls "bokegaeru" (ボケガエル, stupid frog). She deeply cares about her family, and, although she rarely admits it, her surrogate alien "family," and desperately wishes for her mother to spend some quality time with her and Fuyuki. Within her family, Natsumi is probably the only one capable of noticing the presence of the house spirit. Whenever the spirit causes mischief or makes an appearance, Natsumi immediately feels under the weather due to the ghost`s spiritual presence. During her grade-school days in the manga, Natsumi was nicknamed "Devil Summer" (her name literally means "summer beauty") due to her violent temper, though she became more mature when she reached middle school. Although generally tomboyish for her athletism, Natsumi has a number of typical "teenage-girl" insecurities, especially around her crush, Saburo. She is an avid listener to 623`s radio show, though her failure on ever listening to any of her postcards over the show has become a running gag in the series. Natsumi is fairly popular among the alumni at her school, especially among girls due to her masculine interests like sports. One of her most notable admirers is Koyuki Azumaya, her best friend, although Koyuki`s feelings for her may as well extend to a crush (in the manga it is a crush). At times, Natsumi and Keroro seem to absolutely hate each other, as Keroro is an idiotic annoyance to her once-peaceful life and as she herself is Keroro`s main obstacle from world invasion. However, their relationship is one of the most complex within the series, as it varies from rivalry and hate to concern and understanding. Natsumi has feminine interests like sweet things and snacks in general, as well as flowers and cute things, and her least favorite things are said to be anything creepy-crawly, especially slugs. She has the word `summer` in English on her bedroom door, and is part of the kaito team `MorePeachSummerSnow`.

character.name: Tamama Nitouhei
character.description: Tamama is private second class of the Keroro Platoon. He is the newest member in the planetary invasion troop, and also the youngest. His name stems from the Japanese word otamajakushi "tadpole". While his age is unknown, Etsuko Kozakura has stated that she voiced Tamama as someone who was 19 years old. He is a very faithful subordinate to Keroro. Tamama is possessed of a tendency to have mood swings that border on a split personality, just like his partner Momoka Nishizawa. While usually gentle and cheerful, Tamama can become a vengeful, raving maniac at the drop of a hat. This change is usually accompanied by the sound of a balloon popping. Tamama is also prone to fits of jealousy, usually towards anyone who gets near Keroro (especially Angol Mois, who he frequently refers to as "that woman"). Tamama likes junk food (especially candy, cake, cola, and potato chips) and physical training (he has his own private training room in the Nishizawa Mansion). In the anime, Tamama is diagnosed with high blood sugar because of his love of sweets, as revealed with a physical checkup. Tamama`s least favourite sound is nails on a chalkboard. He also dislikes Angol Mois and often calls her "that woman", as he considers her a rival for Keroro`s attention. Despite this, Mois seems blissfully unaware of Tamama`s hatred towards her.

character.name: Dororo Heichou
character.description: Lance Corporal Dororo (Formerly known as Zeroro) is the Keroro Platoon`s assassin who crash landed on Pekopon and was forgotten about by his platoonmates (as usual). Soon after, he found his leg caught in a bear trap and awaited his lonely death, until he was rescued by female ninja Koyuki Azumaya (with the help of Zeroyasha, the dog, in the anime). He decided to follow the way of the ninja, he changed his name to Dororo, the name of the forest where Koyuki rescued him. Dororo is often forgotten about by the rest of the platoon and most everyone else but Koyuki, which will cause his Trauma Switch to turn on. When this happens, a purple, gloomy era radiates from Dororo and he will sit in a corner or dark space and cry. His Trauma switch is usually activated when he is reminded of something done to him by Keroro during thier childhood, Such as using him as a sheild in a snowball fight caused him to remember when he was used in the same way during a dodgeball game. Dororo has a love for all creatures and nature of Pekopon. He has stated that he has "fallen deeply in love" with the planet (Episode 13). As a result, he will not participate in plans that will potentially harm people`s feeling or nature, or endanger any wildlife species on the planet. Dororo has vowed to protect Pekopon at all costs along with Koyuki. As a child, Zeroro loved to garden, which he still does. Dororo even has his own lovely garden in the underground base of the platoon, where he grows both plant species that are native to Pekopon and other alien planets. He uses gardening as a way of meditating (along with reading and actual meditating, usually on top of high places like lamp posts or trees) to train his physical and mental swiftness. Young Zeroro was part of a large, wealthy family. Unfortunately, Dororo has never had a strong aura of presence, much to the point where people won`t notice he`s there even if he`s standing right next to them. Thus, little Zeroro never had many friends until Keroro and Giroro came along. Zeroro would do most anything to stay friends with the two, even when they (mostly Keroro) would often to things that led to his feelings being hurt or his possessions broken, and occasionally physically hurt. Over the years, Keroro has broken Zeroro`s precious music box, used his stamp collection, stolen the strawberries of Zeroro`s cake, wrote all over his books and taken advantage of his kind nature. Despite his mistreatment, Zeroro retained his sweet, humble and kind personality and doesn`t hold a grudge or want revenge against Keroro (unlike his counterpart in the Garuru platoon, Zoruru), though he will break down and cry when reminded of one of his experiences as a child. Dororo used his natural quietness and ability to be unnoticed in the form of stealth after inspired (ironically) by Keroro to become an assassin in the Keronian Military. He joined an elite group of assassins along with Zoruru, led by Jirara, before departing for Pekopon as a Lance Corporal (In the manga, formerly a Private Second Class). Dororo often ends his speech with "De Gozaru", an archaic form of "Desu". Also, Dororo addressed himself as "Sessha", an archaic male form of "I" primarily used by Samurai. Early in the series, one of Dororo`s more common actions was to speak to Keroro and the others in the form of a shuriken made of paper which acted as a note, when needed. The shuriken would always seem to stick itself in Keroro`s head, usually causing him to freak out until it`s removed by another platoonmate. Dororo does not need to be close by to perform this.

episode.title: 冬樹&夏美 勝手に侵入者 であります / ギロロ 趣味の時間 であります
Fuyuki & Natsumi - Convenient Invaders / Giroro - A Time for Hobbies
episode.summary: When Fuyuki and Natsumi stumble into a secret underground alien city, they go undercover as aliens, but with the frogs there too, chances are good that their cover will be blown! Then, after much prodding by Keroro, Giroro tries to find a hobby that suits him. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 夏美 恐怖の身体検査 であります / 冬樹&夏美 姉弟大戦争! であります
Natsumi - The Dreaded Health Inspection / Fuyuki & Natsumi - The Grand Sibling War!
episode.summary: When Natsumi learns of the frogs` latest scheme, which has them impersonating doctors and nurses at a school physical exam, it`s time to bust some heads! That same evening, Fuyuki and Natsumi are having a "sibling spat." Keroro eggs them on to avoid getting in trouble himself, and arm-wrestling ensues... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: タママ 独占! オトナの時間 であります / 冬樹&桃華 ドクタークルルの島 であります
Tamama - Monopoly! A Time for Adults / Fuyuki & Momoka - The Island of Doctor Kururu
episode.summary: Tamama wakes up without a tail! Has he finally become an adult?! And then Momoka hatches yet another wild scheme to spend time with Fuyuki, which lands them on an island with some unexpected Kululu dangers... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ ママ殿癒し系大作戦 であります / ドロロ 沈黙の暴走銀河特急 であります
Keroro - Lord Mama`s Grand Rejuvination / Dororo - Silently Running Wild on the Galaxy Express
episode.summary: It`s Mothers` Day! Natsumi and Fuyuki want to give their mother a special gift, but Keroro has other ideas. And then it`s Space Mothers` Day, with Dororo`s mother visiting! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ すこしふしぎな特効薬 であります / ケロロ すべての道はスターフルーツへ続く! であります
Keroro - Quite Possibly the Best Medicine Ever / Keroro - All Paths Lead to Star Fruits!
episode.summary: Keroro gets terribly sick with some mysterious illness, and the only cure seems to be... starfruit? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 小雪 忍流パジャマパーティー であります / 夏美 ドッキリ家庭訪問! であります
Koyuki - A Shinobi Pajama Party / Natsumi - The Shocking Teacher`s Visit!
episode.summary: Koyuki and Natsumi have a sleepover. And then the frogs decide to impersonate Natsumi`s mother for her teacher`s home visit, somehow thinking this is a good idea. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: クルル & サブロー 出会いはお絵かきガチンコ勝負! であります
Kururu & Saburou - The Artist`s Decisive Encounter!
episode.summary: The unlikely friendship between Kululu and Saburo was formed after a ferocious battle in which they both wielded the Reality Pens. Now Keroro and company dive into Kululu`s memories to go back to that time and try to locate the second reality-altering pen. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 戦え僕らのウェットルキング であります / 夏美 帰ってきたウェットルキング であります
Keroro - Battling Our Wettol King / Natsumi - Returning Home to a Wettol King
episode.summary: After Keroro discovers that Natsumi is terrified of slugs, he has Kululu super-evolve one into a heroic-type humanoid, Wettle King. The faux hero takes on the repulsed Natsumi, but Fuyuki may turn out to be a tougher enemy. Later, Kululu soups up his creation even more, turning him into the more powerful Giant Wettle King, able to take down Natsumi and anyone who sticks up for her. Except, what happens when Wettle King truly starts to become heroic? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ギロロ あだ討ちするはわれにあり! であります / ケロロ またまたまたダソヌ☆マソ? であります
Giroro - My Way of Getting Revenge! / Keroro - Dasonu Maso Again and Again and Again?
episode.summary: Giroro helps two young aliens help themselves when they come to Earth seeking vengeance for their father. Then, Dasonu☆Maso`s younger sister, Dasonu☆Marie, studies comedy by observing the masters, the Keroro platoon! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ ニョロロ対メカニョロロ であります / ケロロ ニョボと共に去りぬ であります
Keroro - Nyororo VS Mecha Nyororo / Keroro - Regarding the Disposal of the Nyobo
episode.summary: Keroro takes a stand against Nyororo`s inevitable annual dehydration attack by creating a mech version of the creature to combat it, while at the same time makes a movie about the situation for a contest. Later, Keroro adopts the refurbished mech as a pet, but Tamama`s jealousy unleashes a danger to the whole planet! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ ピカフロをねらえ! / モア おじさま日記
Keroro - Aiming for that Shining Flow! / Mois - A Diary About Uncle
episode.summary: Keroro realizes that he`s never had a glimmerbath, which is the first bath taken after a tub`s been cleaned and polished. Resentful that Natsumi is always the first in, he tries to get her to concede it to him! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 七夕に願いを! / ケロロ 復活! 怪傑ドーパミン
Keroro - Wishes on Tanabata / Keroro - Revival! The Extraordinarily Talented Dopamine
episode.summary: Desperate to learn Fuyuki`s Tanabata wish, Momoka tries to steal all of the paper strips to read it. But Keroro`s already stolen them, for research into the invasion! And then the Keroro Platoon tries to radiojack 623`s show, faking Sumomo as a guest star again. Giroro`s horrified when they make him play the role all over again. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 幽霊ちゃん 学校へ行こう / クルル カレーの曹長さま
Ghost Girl - Let`s Go to School / Kururu - The Sergeant Major of Curry
episode.summary: The Ghost Girl goes to Natsumi`s school and winds up accidentally possessing a classmate. And then the Keroro Platoon decides to start a curry shop. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ギロロ 壮絶! 夏合宿 / ケロロ 土曜の丑の日をつかまえろ!
Giroro - How Grand! Summer Training Camp / Keroro - Capturing a Late Saturday Night`s Shine!
episode.summary: Giroro sets up a survival camp in the mountains for the Keroro Platoon, but he reckons without Natsumi and Koyuki coming on a camping trip, too. And then, Keroro comes up with the bright idea to mess with Natsumi`s stamina by preventing her from eating eel on Midsummer`s Day! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 土井中海岸リターンズ / 桃華 ひと夏の経験
Keroro - Doinaka Coast Returns / Momoka - One Summer Experience
episode.summary: Hicksville Beach returns! This time, they have a male swimsuit competition, and Natsumi convinces Fuyuki to enter, because the prize is 623`s autograph. Then Momoka gets accidentally hit by Kululu`s aging gun! Why doesn`t anybody recognize her as a sexy adult? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ドロロ くの一カララ シュシュッと参上!
Dororo - The Lady Ninja Karara Makes Her Appearance!
episode.summary: Karara returns, having trained to become Dororo`s bride! But Mecha Viper is back, too. When Karara mistakes Viper for Dororo, she starts begging him to teach her ninjutsu! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: クルル 呪いのDVD / 夏美 何がなんでも禁止よ!
Kururu, The DVD of Curses / Natsumi, By All Means, What is This Prohibition!
episode.summary: After Keroro plays a cursed DVD, he finds himself trapped in his room, with a monster waiting in the hallway. Then, Keroro "helps" the irritable Natsumi by creating a robot that enforces everything she decides to ban, but seems to pick on Giroro especially. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 日向家 里帰り / タママとカメ
Visiting Grandma Hinata`s House / Tamama and the Turtle
episode.summary: The Hinata family and frogs visit Grandma`s house in the countryside for o-bon vacation, but in the woods there seems to be a ghost that can become the very thing they fear. Later, Tamama is training in the mountains at Grandma`s house when he spots a turtle on its way somewhere. Throughout the day and into the night, Tamama checks on its progress until he`s rewarded with knowing the turtle`s final destination. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 夏の宝物
Keroro, That Treasured Summer
episode.summary: Keroro, Dororo, and Giroro are reminded of the summer vacation day they went to Planet Hiquesviel as kids, to search for Viper pirate treasure. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 仁義なき回転寿司! / ケロロ 恐怖のザ・モスキート
Keroro, Morally Spinning Sushi! / Keroro, The Dreaded Mosquito
episode.summary: Keroro takes the whole platoon to get conveyor-belt sushi! And then Keroro gets accidentally turned into a half-mosquito. Will they ever be able to get him back together again? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ&夏美 勇者はどっちだ?!
Keroro & Natsumi, Which Way to Heroes?!
episode.summary: Kululu invents a device that can allow people to enter videogames! Most of the frogs and Natsumi eagerly dive right in. But Giroro can`t stand to let Natsumi rescue the prince, Keroro`s too busy looting to level up, and why is Dasonu Maso the one giving out quests? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ こっそり月旅行 / ギロロ 台風侵略作戦決行!
Keroro - Secret Monday Vacation / Giroro - Typhoon Invasion Operation Commences!
episode.summary: Keroro sneaks off to the moon hoping to dump the invasion deadline counter there, so that he can pretend he never got it. Then the deadline won`t count, right?! But the counter can apparently move, and has ideas of its own. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 最後は本気で神頼み?
Keroro Finally Prays to God?
episode.summary: Desperate to invade the Earth before the deadline, Keroro makes up a fake god and cons people into paying to pray for it. Then, miraculously, their wishes start coming true! Does the invasion actually stand a chance of happening? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: キルル 破滅の使者
Kiruru - The Messenger of Destruction
episode.summary: The invasion deadline counter, Mash, has turned into the horrifying invasion weapon, Kiruru! What`s more, Kiruru has retooled himself to absorb shilly-shallying and procrastination as energy. Is Earth totally doomed?! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ小隊 全員再起動! / ガルル小隊 かく戦えり
Keroro Platoon All Members Reboot! / Garuru Platoon Everyone Fight!
episode.summary: Now that the invasion deadline is no longer haunting them, Keroro is all ready for some well-planned slacking off! The platoon sets up their duplicates to do all of the housework, and they make plans for having fun. But the duplicates are always a recipe for trouble... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ギロロ 秘密の休日 / 梅雄 運動会を支配せよ
Giroro - A Secret Day Off / Baio - Conquer the Sports Festival
episode.summary: Curious about why Giroro`s sneaking away to take a day off, Natsumi decides to follow him by stowing away. The reason isn`t what she expected! And then Momoka`s father will do anything to make sure Sports Day is sunny. But Fuyuki desperately wants it to rain! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ドロロ キッカケが大事! / 夏美 私の青い鳥
Dororo - The Chance is Important! / Natsumi - My Bluebird
episode.summary: A trainee assassin gets sent to take on Dororo for a graduation exam. But how can he possibly defeat such a powerful assassin?! Then Natsumi finds a bluebird she wants to keep as a pet. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: アリサ 闇の狩人 ハロウィン大騒動!
Arisa - Hunter of Darkness, Halloween in Chaos!
episode.summary: It`s Halloween, and everyone is having fun dressing up in costumes to attend a monster-themed party! But then a real alien monster starts stalking Fuyuki... to Momoka`s rage! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 風邪をひいたらアフレコだ!? / 冬樹 & クルル 秋葉原を行く
Keroro If You Catch a Cold, It`ll be Fixed in Post-production!? / Fuyuki & Kururu Go to Akihabara
episode.summary: When Keroro gets a cold, he loses his voice! Is there a frog in his throat? Later, Fuyuki and Kululu are pursued below the streets of Akihabara. Amid all of the mysterious, out-of-place artifacts, can they find a way to fight back against their well-armed opponent? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: カララ & チロロ 七五三に753(なごみ)さん! / ケロロ たかが1粒されど1粒
Karara & Chiroro Nagomi(753)-san / Keroro It`s Only One Grain Left
episode.summary: When Karara and Chiroro come to Earth, they`re chased by a furious, godlike being who will destroy the planet unless the Keroro platoon can somehow soothe his soul. Later, Keroro learns not to waste a single grain of rice after he has a Kululu-influenced realistic dream in which he becomes a rice grain who just wants to be eaten... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 秋 温泉で大合戦! / ケロロ それいけ! ケロロパン
Aki - War at the Onsen!/Keroro - Go! Keroropan
episode.summary: The Hinatas and frogs go on a day trip to a hot spring for Labor Day, but Aki freaks out when she sees a wild monkey in the bath. Her panic leads to an army of more monkeys descending on the hot spring. Later, Keroro and the other members of his platoon are inspired to bake Keronian bread, but little do Fuyuki and Natsumi know that this alien version of bread is more like a battle between edible gargantuan mechs that look like their respective bakers. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ ただいま! と言うまでが遠足だ! / ケロロ 愛と悲しみのスキヤキ
Keroro It`s a Field Trip Until You Say I`m Home! / Keroro Sukiyaki of Love and Sorrow
episode.summary: The platoon sets up an outing to show their appreciation for the Hinata siblings, but when Keroro blows the barbecue money on a Gundam model, he tries to make up for it by profiting from the sale of the General Brat alien`s recital tickets... which doesn`t go so well. Later, Keroro and company try to make up for the previous debacle by preparing a sukiyaki party. Despite a few hitches, it goes smoothly until Kululu decides the event is too boring... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ ケロロショー / 冬樹 & 散世 KGS再び
Keroro Keroro Show / Fuyuki & Chiruyo KGS Returns
episode.summary: Keroro tries to create a tokusatsu character show based on the Keroro Platoon characters! But all does not go according to plan. The newspaper club is also interested in who`s really beneath those costumes... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 556 奥東京市は男の戦場
556 Central Tokyo is a Man`s Battlefield
episode.summary: 556 has caught a space cold, and he`s spreading it to everyone he meets. Horrifyingly, it makes everyone act exactly like him! Just like a Caries War, the Keroro Platoon shrinks down to go into his body and destroy the invaders there. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ小隊 年末調整大作戦 / ケロロ ある男の戦い
Keroro Platoon Super Battle Operation: Tax Return / Keroro A Certain Man`s Fight
episode.summary: The platoon has to spend the remainder of their invasion budget, almost 400 million yen, before the year is up, so they go on a wild, wasteful spending spree that makes Keroro nervous for some reason. Later, Keroro has to do something about his hoarder problem, as he`s got a warehouse full of Gundam models, DVDs, etc, but needs to put everything away in the relatively small confines of his own room. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 奥東京氷河期 アリサが来た!
Keroro Central Tokyo`s Ice Age / Arisa Has Come
episode.summary: The Nishizawa Christmas party looks to be spoiled by a sudden blizzard in Inner-Tokyo that turns into ice age-conditions. Can Fuyuki and Geroro find the culprit before this white Christmas becomes a whiteout? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ お正月を返して! / ギロロ 仕事初めはペコポン侵略!
Keroro, Give me back my New Year / Giroro, Let`s Get Working on the Pekopon Invasion!
episode.summary: Keroro wakes up on January 5th, having slept through the entire New Year`s holiday. He goes on a rampaging temper tantrum! And then the platoon tries to invade right after New Year`s, perhaps to make up for it. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 奇跡!? ケロロの父 / 日向家沈没
Keroro, Miracle?! Keroro`s Father / Hinata House, Submerge!
episode.summary: Keroro`s father drops by to visit, but Mecha Viper R dropped in first! Can Keroro`s father, the ultimate sergeant, save them from the fate of being bronze statues? And then the Hinata house starts sinking, thanks to too much secret base digging underground... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 鉄仮面伝説 謎のデカ耳
Keroro, A Bold-Faced Fake Fairytale The Ear`s Conundrum
episode.summary: There`s a terrible Dekamimian in town, an alien with huge ears who never takes care of his pets! The space police officers want to arrest him, but he knows their faces. So what to do? Why, deputize Natsumi to go undercover, of course! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ウレレ 売れっ子侵略者 / ケロロ そしてやっぱり誰もいなくなった
Urere, the Salesman Invader / Keroro, And After All Even If Everybody Becomes...
episode.summary: Tired of how long the invasion is taking, the Kero Army sends Urere, an incredibly effective invader, to take over in one day! But Keroro seems oddly apathetic about Urere`s strategy. And then 556 invites them over to his place, where a murder mystery ensues... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 冥 おぼえていますか?
Remembered Darkness?
episode.summary: A mysterious transfer student who turns out to be from Pluto is trying to get Earthlings to not forget about her planet. But she`s fighting a losing battle because their memories keep on erasing, no matter what she does about it. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ポール 執事の一分(いちぶん) / ギロロ くれたのは誰?
Paul, A Deacon`s One Minute / Giroro, Rhythm and Pace?
episode.summary: Momoka`s butler, Paul, thinks it`s time to retire, so he tries to find his replacement by hosting a tough audition competition that brings in both mysterious (the Masked Butler) and audacious (Keroro) participants. Later, Valentine`s Day rolls around again and Giroro gets chocolates from Natsumi. Or at least he thinks he does... but to be sure, he has to investigate all the possibilities. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 小雪 時代劇ワンダーランド! / ケロロ チュー兵衛様に飛びつこう!
Koyuki, Historical Theme Wonderland / Keroro, The Mysterious Mouse of the Fantasy Wonderland!
episode.summary: It`s old-timey thrills and chills for our frog friends, when the gang visits Historical Wonderland! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: アリサ エイリアン対モンスター
Alisa, Alien Versus Monster
episode.summary: Alisa`s back, and she`s out to use Fuyuki as bait for further prey. But this time, the residents of Alien Town have caught on to Alisa`s activities, and they`ve decided to draw her out themselves. The hunter may become the hunted! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ギロロ 旅立ちのとき
Giroro, An Established Time to Journey
episode.summary: Giroro learns that he`s been promoted to Platoon Leader for another planetary invasion, and must depart that very night! How will he bid farewell to his beloved Natsumi? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 散世 ホワイトデーをチェック! / 冬樹 ご利用は計画的に
Chiruyo, Checking up on White Day / Fuyuki, I Know How to Use The Application
episode.summary: Keroro has a brilliant plan for White Day: they`re going to make white chocolates and sell them! What could possibly go wrong with... wait, is Kululu involved in this?! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 出没! アド星ック天国
Keroro, Frequent Appearance! Planet Andou`s Heaven
episode.summary: A major intergalactic travel program has chosen Earth to spotlight, and Keroro helped them with the highlights! There`s lots of reminiscing about previous episodes, especially those embarrassing Giroro, but Keroro seems to have something sneaky planned... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ ケロケロ作戦第100号
Kerokero Military Operation, Number 100
episode.summary: The Keroro Platoon is all set to come up with a doozy of a 100th invasion strategy! But then an alien invader, one who swallows up entire planets, approaches. Earth may be doomed. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ さらばケロロ軍曹
Keroro, Farewell Sergeant Keroro
episode.summary: The Keroro Platoon is all set to come up with a doozy of a 100th invasion strategy! But then an alien invader, one who swallows up entire planets, approaches. Earth may be doomed. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ小隊 絶好調! / ケロロ小隊 大共鳴!
Keroro Platoon, Cut a Good Tune! / Keroro Platoon, Large Resonance!
episode.summary: The Keroro Platoon comes up with a new, catchy tune to win the hearts and minds of Pekoponians, starting with the kids at Kissho Academy. Later, when the platoon enters an HQ-sponsored resonance contest, they find that their resonance has unpredictable physical effects on a variety of things around them. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 合体! ケロロロボ / ケロロ 侵略! 桜最前線
Keroro, Unite! Keroro Robo / Keroro, Invasion! Cherry Blossom Frontline Extreme!
episode.summary: When Mecha Viper returns (again) for revenge, the Keroro Platoon tests out their new robots on him. Later, the platoon attempts a new challenge, securing a space at a park for cherry blossom viewing, the night before a prime viewing day. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: プルル 看護長におまかせ! / 夏美 今日の占い
Pururu, A Chief Medic`s Safeguard! / Natsumi, Today`s Fortune Telling
episode.summary: Pururu: Leave It to the Chief Nurse, Sir! / Natsumi: Today`s Horoscope, Sir! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 過去の栄光 / ギロロ 禁断の記憶
Keroro, Past Glories / Giroro, Prohibit those Memories!
episode.summary: The Keroro Platoon has one day to send a report to HQ that details all of their invasion efforts since arriving on Pekopon, so they start crafting a heroic narrative on DVD by editing in bits and pieces of video footage from their misadventures. Later, Chief Nurse Pururu wants to know what the platoon has really been up to all this time, so Keroro gives her and the other members a peek into the memories of a reluctant Giroro... but Kululu and Keroro quickly get sidetracked with the amusing prank of editing Giroro`s memories. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 白熱! カードバトル / ケロロ 狙われた小隊
Keroro, Climax! Card Battle / Keroro, A Proposal to Dissolve the Platoon
episode.summary: Keroro orders Kululu to build him a collectible card game that he can use to market and make loads of money! But, of course, he has to beat the whole platoon to prove how superior he is with it. And then a mysterious organization seems to have been keeping tabs on the Keroro Platoon... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 桃華 最強の母の日
Momoka, The Strongest Mother`s Day
episode.summary: Momoka`s mother decides to come and visit for Mothers` Day! This is more terrifying than it sounds, as she`s a notorious street fighter who will break through any defenses, including the elite corps of bodyguards, Paul, and her husband in order to see her daughter again. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: プタタ & メケケ 必殺お仕事人
Putata & Mekeke, Zealous Killers
episode.summary: The insane Keronian Putata puts in an appearance, with a strange paint that can make things become real. Worse, Mekeke, the puppetmaster, shows up with him. Will the Keroro Platoon ever be able to defeat them, or are they about to lose their secret base for good? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ちびケロ あのころジョリリ
Chibi Kero, That Time Joriri
episode.summary: After Kululu locks the rest of the platoon into their new secret base, Keroro and the rest reminisce about their childhood secret base, and a strange Keronian they knew named Joriri. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 夏美 さよならサブロー / 冬樹&アリサ 雨の怪物
Natsumi, Saburo, Is This Goodbye? / Fuyuki and Alisa, The Rain`s Monster
episode.summary: Natsumi gets a double-whammy of bad news: Saburo, her crush, is switching schools, and her favorite radio show host, 623, is taking his act to the US! Ninja Koyuki stealth-drags Natsumi to the station to find out the truth, even as the Keroro platoon "radio-jacks" the show. Later, Alisa Southerncross returns to hunt in Inner-Tokyo when a creature makes it rain incessantly... but only in Fuyuki`s general vicinity, for some reason. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ ニョロロ滅亡? / ラビー お嫁に行きます!
Keroro, Nyororo Destruction? / Rabbi, Script of an Honorable Bride!
episode.summary: While fleeing from the annual rainy season Nyororo, Keroro and crew head back billions of years into the past, where they have a chance to wipe out the Nyororo before they come into existence! Then 556 is upset when his little sister, Lavie, is about to get married, but the romantic Natsumi enlists Keroro`s help to convince him to accept it! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: クルル 臨時隊長 / 小雪 普通猛特訓
Kururu, Temporary Leader / Koyuki, Training Hard as Usual
episode.summary: When Keroro is hospitalized with a bad back, Kululu becomes acting commander in his place, a terrifying prospect for the rest of the platoon when they have to show hospitality to a peevish but important ambassador from another planet. Later, right when ninja Koyuki wants to become "normal," the Keroro platoon invites her to join their new "Let`s Become Normal" class, but little does she suspect it`s really their secret plan to turn her into a Pekoponian spy! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ くだけ! ウェットルロボ / ケロロ 突撃! ウェットルヒューマン
Keroro, Smash! Wettol Robo / Keroro, Assault! Wettol Human
episode.summary: While the real Wettle King is on a heroic journey out in space, Keroro and crew build a robotic impostor to take on "Natsumigeddon" again! Later on, when Kululu uses a giant slug to make yet another version that ends up menacing everyone, can the real Wettle King save the day, even though he`s millions of miles away? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 556 カップメンの作り方 / ケロロ 攻略! クロスワード
556 Cup Noodles Recipes / Keroro, Capture! Crossword
episode.summary: Lavie wins cup ramen in a supermarket raffle, and 556 tries to figure out what it is and how it works! Later, Keroro is determined to complete a crossword puzzle, wrongly assuming that the prize is a year`s supply of Gundam models! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 期間限定大侵略 / 桃華 七夕限定の私
Keroro, The Big Plan for Period Restriction / Momoka, My Limited Tanabata
episode.summary: Keroro notices that when things are available as exclusive, limited-time-only versions, people value them more. So he has Kululu build a gun to turn anything they want into these! But when the exclusive items flip over to "no longer available," the trouble begins... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ウレレ 電車の王様 / ギロロ 美少女と液体ケロン人
Urere, The Reverend King of the Trains / Giroro, Beauty and the Liquid Keronian
episode.summary: Urere, the popular invader, shows up again, this time with a plan he doesn`t mind letting the Keroro Platoon take credit for! But while his train tracks are crisscrossing Japan, there might just be an ulterior motive hidden behind them. Later, Giroro gets turned into a liquid and helplessly tries to protect Natsumi. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 冬樹&ケロロ あばけ! 七不思議 / プルル&散世 秘密の友だち
Fuyuki and Keroro, Inaccurately! The Seven Wonders / Pururu and Chiruyo, Secret Friends
episode.summary: Fuyuki and Keroro go to investigate the seven mysteries of the school. And then Pururu decides to stay with a certain memo-taking member of the Journalism Club who thinks the aliens are a comedy troupe... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: タママ 理由なき反抗 / クルル と お留守番?
Tamama, Rebellion is a Regrettable Reason / Kururu, When is He a House-sitter?
episode.summary: Tamama is going through a natural rebellious stage in his life and to help him get through it, the rest of the Keroro platoon and the Hinata siblings must go through a specific set of steps... but every time someone screws up, they have to start over again! Will Tamama ever get past being a delinquent?! Later, while Kululu is left home alone, an automatic invasion machine is about to attack Earth. The unlikely trio of Fuyuki, Natsumi, and Kululu team up to stop it! Though you never know with Kululu... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: アリサ & 冬樹 UMA対ダンガル!
Arisa and Fuyuki, UMA Vs. Dangal!
episode.summary: When the Hinata family and the Keroro platoon make their annual trip to Hicksville Beach, they find that it`s "gone Hollywood" over the upcoming US feature film adaptation of Gundam ripoff Dangal. But there are also two UMAs in town and at least one of them is there to make trouble. Monster-hunting living doll Alisa enters the fray to stop them and chow down, but finds that there`s more than meets the eye with her prey. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ ヤマトとカプー でありんす
Keroro, Yamato and Kappa
episode.summary: When Fuyuki goes looking for a kappa in a small town on the outskirts of Tokyo, Keroro ends up being abducted by a boy who takes the sergeant to be his lost (kappa?) friend, Capu. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ ブッチャ毛 アフロで音頭? / ドロロ 不思議の山
Keroro, Butchered Hair, and the Afro Ondo? / Dororo, Mysterious Mountain
episode.summary: Keroro and his squad hold a concert for worldwide broadcast, featuring DANCE☆MAN! (Or is it...?) Then, while everyone is visiting Grandma Akina, Dororo meets a mysterious girl in the mountains. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 飛び込め! ビニールプール / 冬樹 & 夏美 新しい朝がきた
Keroro, Dive! Vinyl Swimming Pool / Fuyuki & Natsumi, A New Morning Has Come
episode.summary: Desperate to escape the summer heat, Keroro and the rest shrink themselves down to tiny size in order to enjoy a child`s wading pool as a fantastically huge place to swim. But it goes terribly wrong when full-sized Natsumi decides to go into the pool, too. Soon after that, Natsumi and Fuyuki decide to find out where the frogs have been sneaking off to every morning... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ちびケロ さらば夏休み!
Chibi Kero, Farewell to Summer Vacation!
episode.summary: Distressed by his summer homework, which he left until the last minute again, Fuyuki goes complaining to Keroro, who reminisces about his childhood one summer in which he did the same thing. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ドクク ガスケロン人第1号 / ケロロ ペコポン一のガンプラ男
Dokuku, Gas Keronian is No. 1 / Keroro, Pekopon`s Gunpla Man
episode.summary: Another member of the Shurara Corps, a Keronian who`s made entirely out of gas, appears! And then Keroro decides to invade the Earth by using Gundam models. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 桃華 ゴースト 日向家の幻
Momoka, Ghost: The Hinata Family`s Phantom
episode.summary: Still too shy to say anything to Fuyuki about wanting to spend time with him, Momoka begs the Keroro Platoon to turn her into a ghost so that she can follow him around to her heart`s content. Kululu`s machine may work, but... is there actually any way to turn her back again? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 出馬する! / 夏美&ギロロ 帰れない二人
Keroro, Running for Election! / Natsumi and Giroro, the Two Who Are Unable to Return
episode.summary: Still too shy to say anything to Fuyuki about wanting to spend time with him, Momoka begs the Keroro Platoon to turn her into a ghost so that she can follow him around to her heart`s content. Kululu`s machine may work, but... is there actually any way to turn her back again? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 争奪大戦争
Keroro, War Is a Big Scramble
episode.summary: Karara and Chiroro show up again, intent on winning Keroro`s heart! But Tamama cannot bear that, and Mois-chan is hurt that they are even trying. Pururu shows up to save the day, but maybe she is not as helpful as they all think, either! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ムシシ 虫の居所を探せ! / 桃華 争奪! 二人三脚
Mushishi, Search for the Insects! / Momoka, Three-Legged Race!
episode.summary: A former Keronian assassin and insect fan shows up to tell the Keroro platoon that Pekoponian emotions can be controlled through the placement of bugs. Keroro insists they use Natsumi as the first test subject! Later, Momoka`s larger-than-life parents duel over which of them gets to participate in the parent-child three-legged race. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 埋蔵金スペシャル / タママ 対 タママ
Keroro, Buried Treasure Special / Tamama Vs. Tamama
episode.summary: When Keroro and Fuyuki go looking for buried treasure near Grandma`s house, Keroro suffers a bump that sends him spinning back in time to the Edo period. Later, Tamama is confronted with an almost-exact duplicate of himself, but has to prove that he`s the one and only Private Tamama... if he`s not the fake. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ガルル はた迷惑なバケーション
Garuru, A Repeat of Annoyance - Vacation
episode.summary: Giroro`s big brother, Galulu, returns to Earth, but this time he`s on vacation. Awkwardness abounds as the two gruff brothers take tentative steps to becoming closer, but can they work together as one to defeat a giant flying mutant potato? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 冬樹 オカルト文化祭 / 夏美 ロミオとジュリエット?
Fuyuki, Occult Culture Festival / Natsumi, Romeo and Juliet?
episode.summary: At Kissho Academy`s annual festival, Fuyuki tries giving a presentation on paranormal powers, but is heckled mercilessly by two self-styled "Occult Busters." Then, Natsumi`s in a bind when many of the actors and stagehands for her class`s production of Romeo and Juliet come down with food poisoning. When Giroro learns that Natsumi herself is playing one of the leads, he agonizes over whether he should step in and take the romantic co-starring role. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ロボボ 機械化大作戦 / タママ ノートですぅ
Robobo, Large Mechanized Operations / Tamama, Notebook
episode.summary: The Shurara Corps has resorted to sending a robo-frog to destroy the Keroro Platoon! And then Tamama finds a notebook that makes people say whatever he writes in it. He`s very excited about the power this gives him -- until an apple-eating Kululu starts explaining the rules. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ギロロ 目標!プレゼント! / ケロロ 誕生日大パーティー
Giroro, Target! Present! / Keroro, Big Birthday Party!
episode.summary: Giroro has a hard time finding the perfect birthday gift for Natsumi, and once he finally thinks he`s got it, there`s only one left, and he`ll have to fight with a member of the Viper clan over it. Later, Giroro is overcome with jealousy and anxiety when Natsumi leaves home on her birthday, perhaps to meet up with Saburo for a date... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ドロロ 過去からの刺客
Dororo, Assassin From the Past
episode.summary: Captain Jirara, Dororo`s former superior officer, has gone AWOL from the Keron Army. Dororo has a suspicion that Captain Jirara is somewhere on Earth, but facing him will require Dororo facing up to his dark past as an assassin in their former platoon. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ヌイイ ボクを捨てないで!
Nuii, Don`t Abandon Me!
episode.summary: Natsumi finds a stuffed toy in the trash that reminds her of a beloved stuffed toy from her childhood. So she brings it home and fixes it up. But could that toy actually be part of a trap from the Shurara Corps? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 勤労を感謝せよ / ケロロ 戦え!ワキレンジャー
Keroro, Thanksgiving is a way to work / Keroro, Fight! WakiRanger
episode.summary: It`s Labor Thanksgiving Day, and Keroro waits for the platoon to shower him with appreciation for all of his hard work. But... what`s this? They want him to show THEM appreciation instead?! Gero! And then Keroro makes condiments center stage when his invasion plan centers around them. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: アリサvs妖怪 侵略が進まない
Arisa vs Ghost, Aggression is the Lack of Progress
episode.summary: Thinking it will make a good excuse, Keroro makes up a yokai called "Invasion Goes Nowhere," and blames it for their failure to invade the planet Earth. But when he starts impersonating said yokai to play pranks on the others in his platoon, he gets an unexpected visitor -- Alisa, who wants to hunt him as one of those that lurk in the darkness! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ あいつとララバイ伝説 / ケロロ プラモ王大決戦!
Keroro, His Lullaby Legend / Keroro, Decisive Plastic Model Battle!
episode.summary: When Mom is ready to retire their old vacuum cleaner for a new model, vacuum jockey Keroro soups up the machine so the Hinatas will keep it, but maybe Keroro makes it a bit too powerful... Later, Keroro has forgotten the important thing about building plastic models until a mysterious masked figure challenges him to a model-building competition. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ クリスマスを防止せよ! / ケロロ小隊 ケーキは男の戦場だ!
Keroro, Christmas Prevent! / Keroro Platoon Cake is a Man`s Battlefield!
episode.summary: When Keroro gets irked by a store that`s sold out of a new Gundam model because of Christmas shopping, he takes revenge by wiping out all memories and traces of the special day in Inner-Tokyo, but he still has to neutralize Santa Claus somehow... And on Christmas Day, the Keroro Platoon shrinks itself for a battle royal atop a Christmas cake! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 夏美 私もスキーに連れてって! / ケロロ 温泉っつうたら卓球だ!
Natsumi, I Said I Want to Go Skiing Too! / Keroro, Hot Spring, Tiring Tennis Match!
episode.summary: When Keroro suggests going on a skiing vacation, Natsumi accepts readily. But of course, Aki insists they have to have an adult with them. And then, just like at Hicksville Beach, it turns out there`s another rare Gundam knock-off that`s going to the winner of a skiing competition! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: トイレ 今,立ち上がるとき! / クルル と 子犬
Invasion Plan, Toilet! / Kururu and the Puppy
episode.summary: Keroro has the brilliant plan of turning toilets into Transformers in order to invade. Naturally, nothing can go wrong, such as a robot uprising. And then Kululu seems to have adopted... a puppy?! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 仁義なき初詣 / ケロロ セチラ対ゾニラ
Keroro, New Years` Shrine Visit without Honor or Humanity / Keroro, Sechira Versus Zonira
episode.summary: When the Hinatas and the Keroro Platoon visit a shrine on New Year`s Day, Keroro has the perfect visit in mind that will give him guaranteed good luck for the whole year. Later, his plan seems not to have worked as some traditional New Year`s space food he introduces turns out to be sentient and menacing. Can the Hinata family`s traditional New Year`s soup save the day? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 帰ってきたゲロゲロ30分
Keroro Special Returns! Gero Gero 30 Minutes, 13 Stories
episode.summary: It`s another thirteen-episodes-in-one special! The Keroro Platoon tries to think of lots of strange invasion ideas, Giroro mistakes a "bath" for a "battle," and there`s a special live action segment of the platoon! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ ウルーが来る!
Keroro, Uru Has Come!
episode.summary: After hearing about Leap Day, Keroro gets terrified that a giant monster named Uruu will come to beat all the invaders. Thanks to his terror, the monster actually appears! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: クルル クルルンアイドル伝説 / ケロロ 初心に帰る!
Kururu, Kururun Idol Legend / Keroro, Resetting My Mind!
episode.summary: Kululu becomes a really popular idol. He takes advantage of it to be even more of a jerk than ever. And then Keroro decides the platoon needs to return to their roots as invaders... by acting like stereotype villains, complete with costume changes! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ちびケロ チビチビ大冒険! / 夏美&桃華 義理チョコ禁止!
Chibi Kero, Little-Little Big Adventure! / Natsumi and Momoka, Obligation Chocolate Excluded!
episode.summary: When Keroro, Giroro, and Zeroro were children, they found some candies that Kululu dropped that made them really small. And then an overwhelmed Natsumi wishes there was no such thing as obligation chocolate on Valentine`s Day. Kululu is happy to oblige... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ゼロロ 増えすぎ? / ケロロ 穴があったら掘りたい!
Zeroro, Multiplying? / Keroro, I Want to Dig Holes!
episode.summary: In their childhood, Keroro, Giroro, and Zeroro happened upon a matter duplicator. Keroro forced Zeroro to be duplicated umpteen times, despite his many protests. Back in the present, the Keroro Platoon is being troubled by holes appearing randomly all over the place. And it`s caused by... drill-ogres?! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ギロロ 3月3日は耳の日? / ケロロ じゃなくて女の戦い
Giroro, the Third of March is Ear Day? / Keroro, It`s Not A Woman`s Fight
episode.summary: The Keroro Platoon infects Earthlings with a virus that makes them want to clean each others` ears. And then the girls fight over a magic ball that can make one of their wishes come true. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 激闘! 最後のお仕事人
Keroro, Attack! The Last Worker
episode.summary: The Shurara Corps sends yet another assassin, Yukiki, to take down the Keroro Platoon. Then Keroro discovers that he actually has Shurara`s address! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ シュララ最終決戦!
Keroro, Shurara, Final Brawl!
episode.summary: In this full-length episode, the Keroro Platoon bring out brand-new mech units in a final battle against the vengeful Shurara and his all-powerful Keromet, which has a will of its own and intends to devour Earth! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 武者ケロ 壱の巻 伝説の勇者 でござ候
Musha Kero, Volume 1: Legendary Hero
episode.summary: The entire platoon gets sent to Sengoku Ran Star to find a legendary Keronian treasure. But the sixth son of the Viper clan is out to stop them. While undercover as warriors from the Warring States period, can the Keroro Platoon prevail? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 夏美 困惑の放課後 / 秋 子供の日
Natsumi, Disturbance After School / Aki, Children`s Day
episode.summary: Natsumi gets abducted by aliens who feed off confusion energy! And then Aki accidentally gets turned into a child. How do they turn her back again? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 小雪 忍び, やめます
Koyuki, I`ll Stop Being A Shinobi
episode.summary: A childhood friend of Koyuki`s (and fellow ninja) invites her to join his organization so she can employ her ninja skills to the fullest and really belong somewhere. On the downside, his group is trying to take over the world, which the Keroro Platoon isn`t too happy about when they find out... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ギロロ オトコのバックアップ / ケロロ お得な携帯大作戦!
Giroro, A Man`s Backup / Keroro, Mobile Profit Big Plan!
episode.summary: When an alien computer virus infects the platoon`s secret base, Giroro attempts to go in alone to wipe it out, only to find that he needs backup from an unexpected source. Later, Keroro enacts a nefarious invasion plan to hook the world on his K-Phone, but then discovers that the "almighty phone" has an invasion function... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 会社を作ろう! / 桜華 桜と共に来る
Keroro, Build A Company! / Mother, Come With Cherry Blossoms
episode.summary: Keroro forms a company and has grand plans to make it a success... except he has no idea what kind of work they`re supposed to be doing. Later, Momoka is anxiously awaiting her mostly-absent, globetrotting, street-fighting mother, who promised to visit before the cherry blossoms fell. The problem is, they`ve all but fallen, and Ouka is nowhere in sight. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ小隊 色々作戦開始! / ドロロ 納豆はお好き?
Keroro Platoon, Start the Color Operation! / Dororo, Do You Like Natto?
episode.summary: Keroro is in the doldrums at the start of the fifth season until a burst of color reinvigorates all of the platoon members. Later, Keroro has Dororo come up with the first invasion plan of the year, but they`re surprised or just turned off when it involves soybeans fermented with bacteria, or sticky, stinky natto! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ & 冬樹 もう一つの世界
Keroro and Fuyuki, Another World
episode.summary: Keroro accidentally gets on board a train that takes him to a parallel world where he and Fuyuki have never met. That world`s Fuyuki is ecstatic to meet an alien, while our world`s Fuyuki is wondering sadly where his friend went. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ロボ 556 / ケロロ & 夏美 雨宿り
Robo Kogoro / Keroro and Natsumi, Shelter From The Rain
episode.summary: 556 becomes the Keroro Platoon`s guinea pig by volunteering to be turned into a robot. On the upside, he`ll never go hungry again, but one disadvantage is he`s now under Keroro`s (remote) control. Later, Keroro feels guilty after accidentally breaking Aki`s coffee mug, so he goes out to secretly buy a replacement, which leads to getting caught in the rain and taking shelter under an awning with Natsumi for some reason. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 8人のウェットルキング / ケロロ ガマ3号ウェット大作戦
Keroro, Eight Men of the Wettol King / Keroro, Gamma 3`s Big Wet Idea
episode.summary: When Keroro has Kululu create seven Wettle King replicas to go after Natsumi, a mysterious young man shows up to save her. Later, a Nyoro-Wettle King hybrid takes over the platoon`s space station, prompting the frogs and Hinata siblings to go into space to take it back. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: クルル やめます / プルル 恋する看護兵
Kururu, I Quit / Pururu, Nurse In Love
episode.summary: Kululu suddenly quits the platoon and somehow starts working for Momoka`s father, which is only the beginning of his meteoric rise. Later, when Pururu goes undercover at Natsumi`s sleepover, she seems to inadvertently reveal that she`s in love with one of Keroro`s old friends, which drives Sarge crazy... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 桃華 明日を取り戻せ!
Momoka, Reclaim Tomorrow!
episode.summary: The platoon goes on a training camp, but Keroro and Giroro are both desperate to find a photograph of Natsumi before she finds it. Later, Space Inspector K shows up, looking for a terrible space felon. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ それだけは見ないで! / 556 vs 宇宙警視
Keroro, Don`t Look At That! / Kogoro vs. Space Superintendant
episode.summary: The platoon goes on a training camp, but Keroro and Giroro are both desperate to find a photograph of Natsumi before she finds it. Later, Space Inspector K shows up, looking for a terrible space felon. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 地球温暖化ってなぁに? / サババ 砂漠の魔王
Keroro, What is Global Warming? / Sababa, Devil King of The Desert
episode.summary: Dororo`s very concerned about global warming, and tries to educate Keroro to be less wasteful to help avert it. Keroro is not interested in interrupting his conveniences, though. Then the platoon goes to Egypt to look for an ancient Keronian treasure. Instead, they wind up waking up Sababa, demon lord of the desert! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 武者ケロ 弐の巻 爆笑! 戦国お笑い合戦 でござそうろう
Musha Kero, Volume 2: Outburst of Laughter, Crushing Comedian War!
episode.summary: It`s Volume II of Musha Kero, and there`s a swimsuit comedy contest on Sengoku Ran Star! Two Viper brothers are teaming up to compete with the Keroro Platoon... and the prize is the next Keronian treasure the frogs have been sent to get! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ちびケロ 耳をすませば / ケロロ カリエスウォー2
Chibi Kero, When Your Ear is Stolen / Keroro, Caries War 2
episode.summary: First, Keroro and his friends in childhood find a broken-down robot that they try to repair. Then, back in the present, they have to fight a Caries War inside Keroro again! But something seems funny about these mouth-invaders... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ちびケロ 禁じられた遊び / ケロロ 恐怖の侵略者
Chibi Kero, The Forbidden Game / Keroro, Frightening Invaders
episode.summary: Back in their childhood, Zororo gets a copy robot as a gift from his parents. Naturally, Keroro decides to abuse it. Returning to the present, a fire scare at the base prompts Keroro to take a fire safety class. But he gets sold the wrong textbooks, and gets the runaround when he tries to return them! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 圧縮で侵略? / 冬樹 日向家財宝伝説
Keroro, Compressed Invasion? / Fuyuki, Legendary Things in The Hinata House
episode.summary: When Keroro is forced to go through an enormous backlog of unfinished manga, anime, and Gundam models, Kululu helps pick up the pace by introducing the pachyderm-like Compressor-kun, which compresses anything and everything into just the essentials. Later, Fuyuki and Keroro go on a treasure hunt in the house! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 桃華 決戦は日曜日 / ギロロ 決戦は日曜日
Momoka, Decision on Sunday / Giroro, Decision on Sunday
episode.summary: Momoka`s very excited to go out on (what she thinks is) a date with Fuyuki-kun. Meanwhile, Giroro`s very excited to go out on (what he hopes is) a date with Natsumi. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 雨の日はせんべい釣り! / ケロロ 思い出と花火
Keroro, Fishing Rice Cookies on Rainy Days / Keroro, Memories and Fireworks
episode.summary: The platoon and the Hinata family go to visit Grandma. But when they arrive, it`s raining! Grandma teaches them a fun game, and then the platoon comes up with a way to repay her for all the nice things she`s always doing. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 桃華 女だらけの無人島 / ケロロ 恐怖の赤い靴作戦
Momoka, Unformed Girl Of An Isolated Island / Keroro, Frightening Red Shoes Mission
episode.summary: Momoka, Natsumi, Koyuki, and two of Natsumi`s friends all get shipwrecked on an uninhabited island. "Little green fairy" Keroro is not exactly helpful. Later, the platoon creates a pair of scary red shoes that won`t stop dancing. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ セレブリゾート捜査網
Keroro, That`s Right, Celebrity Resort
episode.summary: While everyone`s vacationing in Alien Town, Poyon spies them and convinces Natsumi to investigate a crime on her behalf. All signs seem to point to Keroro... but would he really have pulled off a precious jewel heist? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: タママ 美しきダイブ! / ケロロ 究極のペコポン人スーツ
Tamama, Beautiful Dive! / Keroro, The Best Pekoponian Suit
episode.summary: Tamama`s desperate to jump off the high-dive, but he`s afraid he`s too immature. Later, Keroro is wandering around thinking he`s a human businessman. How in the world did this happen? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 冬樹 遠い海から来たカメ
Fuyuki, From a Distant Ocean Came a Turtle
episode.summary: Fuyuki finds a little turtle who turns out to be an extremely endangered species from space. Keroro is super jealous of his new rival for Fuyuki`s affection, which results in him hurting the turtle and going crazy trying to find a way to heal it again. Meanwhile, an evil gang of three thieves are out to take the turtle back and sell it! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ & 夏美 ひとつの部屋
Keroro and Natsumi, One Room
episode.summary: Keroro wants to teach Natsumi a lesson about how superior he is. But he makes the mistake of asking for Kululu`s help, resulting in the two of them getting trapped in a dangerous room while Kululu goes out for curry. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: メルル 郵便で~す! / 冬樹 パーキングエリアで一服
Meruru, Postal Service! / Fuyuki, A Break in the Parking Area
episode.summary: Intergalactic mail carrier Meruru has a letter for Keroro, but he suspects it`s an ultimatum from Keron Army HQ, so does everything he can to avoid receiving it. Later, after a fight with his sister, Fuyuki joins Keroro on a flying bike ride and they end up at a hidden alien parking area on Earth. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ コトバの必殺拳! / サブロー & クルル 静かな戦い
Keroro, Killer Fist of Words! / Saburo and Kululu, Silent Fight
episode.summary: When sound suddenly disappears all over Inner-Tokyo, Keroro comes up with a way to use the situation for the invasion. Later, Saburo and Kululu discover what`s behind the enforced silence, and they are the only ones who can bring sound back. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 桃華 愛の節約作戦 / ゼロロ キカカがやってきた
Momoka, Big Operation: Love Savings / Zeroro, I Finally Found Kikaka
episode.summary: Mindful that her mega-expensive plans to capture Fuyuki`s heart never succeed, Momoka gives Paul a budget of just 300 yen to come up with something that will bring her together with Fuyuki. And before Dororo became Dororo, he was Zeroro on Keron. One day, a robot appears out of nowhere to save Zeroro from peril and from then on, they live together... until the Keron army gets wind of it. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 武者ケロ 参の巻 大爆発 桃姫危機一髪!! でござそうろう
Musha Kero: Volume 3, Big Explosion, Close Call For Princess Momo
episode.summary: The Keroro Platoon continues its top-secret mission on the planet Sengoku Ran. This time they try to rescue Princess Momo before she`s forced to marry a Viper, with explosive results! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ ボードロボー / ケロロ ひ~ろ~ず
Keroro, Board Robbing / Keroro, Heroes
episode.summary: Keroro`s board gets stolen, and he`s devastated. But when he goes out searching for it, he discovers Mecha Viper, of all people! Since the platoon`s developed superpowers, they decide to take on Mecha Viper in their most epic battle yet! (They think...) Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 秋 編集者は強し!
Aki, A Little Over Than Editor!
episode.summary: Aki`s been chosen as the replacement editor for a new mangaka at work, and he`s having trouble telling stories with energy. She brings him home to meet Keroro and the rest of the platoon -- because the frogs are bursting with energy! Too bad it seems to drive the poor mangaka crazy. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ テロップ大作戦 / ケロロ ハウツー本で侵略
Keroro, TV Projector Big Plan / Keroro, Invade By How-To Book
episode.summary: Kululu invents a telop machine that makes whatever you write on the screen of the show come true! After having fun tormenting Natsumi, Keroro declares this is the perfect tool to use to invade the Earth. But no one can agree about how to use it! Later, they find a how-to book about invasions. It was written by Urere, so it has to be useful! Right? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 冬樹 と 首長竜
Fuyuki and The Plesiosaur
episode.summary: Sassie, the plesiosaur of Lake Sashida, was long ago denounced as a fraud. But a new witness has come forth claiming to have seen it, and Fuyuki can hardly wait to learn if it`s true! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ ガム噛む? / タママ タママタンゴ
Keroro, Chewing Gum? / Tamama, Tamama Tango
