episode.summary: The new Pekoponian invasion plan calls for mass distribution of Kululu-created bubble gum that causes various annoying effects like weightlessness and the compulsion to litter (and then step on it). Later on, after the platoon gathers mushrooms, a witch hunt ensues to find the Keronian who ate a poisonous mushroom that will turn him into a contagious Mushroom Man. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 武者ケロ 四の巻 武者ケロ小隊 西へ!! でござそうろう
Musha Kero, Volume 4: Go West, Musha Kero Platoon
episode.summary: The Musha Kero Platoon sets out to find the fourth ancient weapon and run into Mutsuzo, a Mutsumi lookalike who longs to be a manga artist but has no talent whatsoever. Meanwhile, another Musha Viper shows up with his giant robot to plunder and wreak havoc. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ アタック! ヒントで年の差ウルトラハンマー / ドロロ 大改造!
Keroro, Attack! Hint Age Difference Ultra Hammer / Dororo, Big Change!
episode.summary: When the Keroro Platoon participates in a quiz show hosted by Dasonu Maso, they learn the value of teamwork... or is it every frog for himself? Later, Keroro and company are annoyed when the pacifistic Dororo shoots down even their mildest plans to invade Pekopon, so they change his personality to be more agreeable, but (naturally) get more than they asked for. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 夏美 もしかして三角関係? / プルル お見合い大作戦!
Natsumi, Is it a Love Triangle? / Pururu, Big Marriage Meeting Plan!
episode.summary: When Natsumi spots Koyuki and Saburo together, she comes to the conclusion that they`re dating, and goes batty. Later, Keron Army HQ tries to set up Chief Nurse Pururu with a potential suitor. Pururu isn`t really interested, but Keroro gets in the way by trying to help Pururu land this "big tuna." Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: クルル 特命曹長 / ケロロ 伝説の朝
Kururu, Excellent Sergeant Major / Keroro, Morning of Legends
episode.summary: Kululu and Saburo seem to have something up their sleeves. Keroro`s afraid Kululu is reporting about them to HQ, and Giroro`s afraid it has something to do with Natsumi! And then Fuyuki wants a new video game, but his mother won`t let him stand in line outside to get a limited-edition copy. So Keroro goes in his place. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 556 今は言えない / ケロロ 掃除機よ永遠なれ!
Kogoro, Now I Can`t Tell You / Keroro, Cleaning Eternally!
episode.summary: 556 requests Keroro`s help in protecting him from "them." He seems extremely paranoid, and won`t explain what`s going on. Then Kululu turns the vacuum cleaner, among other household appliances, into a human. Strange things happen at the Hinata house as a result! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 屋根裏の散歩者 であります / ケロロ 自意識過剰で侵略! であります
Keroro, Ceiling Walker / Keroro, Self-Consciousness Invasion
episode.summary: Keroro finds a strange warped crawl space that allows him to play pranks by dangling over Natsumi and Giroro`s ceilings. Later, he has the good idea of invading by making everyone on Earth think they`re being watched constantly. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 戦場はメリークリスマス
Keroro, The Battlefield is a Merry Christmas
episode.summary: Keron Army HQ has sent the Keroro Platoon a Christmas present... of Kiruru, the deadly robot! The Keroro Platoon has to go up against him to try to save the Earth from being destroyed. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 落書きの住人 であります / ケロロ 年越し大騒動 であります
Keroro, Graffiti Dweller / Keroro, Great Tumult Through Another Year
episode.summary: Keroro is cleaning the bathrooms when he discovers a bunch of graffiti that writes itself. Talking with them, he meets the graffiti-dwellers, and even becomes one of them! But then he`s left all alone over New Year`s. It`s not quite fun being flat when he can`t even invade his favorite show on TV! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 初侵略作戦! であります / 556 傷ついたヘルメット であります
Keroro, New Year Invasion Plans! / Kogoro, Scratched Helmet
episode.summary: Keroro has the perfect first dream of the new year to herald a successful invasion, so he immediately decides to throw a party to celebrate their imminent success. Spending the entire budget on the first day must be a great idea! Then 556 scratches his helmet, and he goes to Kululu to get his personality (and helmet) new and improved. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ギロロ うがい猛特訓! / ケロロ ケロ消し
Giroro, Special Gargling Training! / Keroro, Kero-Eraser!
episode.summary: Giroro is so desperate to learn how to gargle, he has Kululu inject him with a space virus that he`ll catch if he doesn`t learn it, quick! And then Keroro decides to make Keroro Platoon collectible erasers. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: モア リップスティック・スラップスティック であります / ケロロ 脱出! ケロンバーフィールド であります
Mois, Lipstick Slapstick / Keroro, Get Out! Keron Bar Field
episode.summary: Mois gets some lipstick as a sample, and she`s excited that it makes her look and feel more adult. Later, Kululu`s lab gets trashed and the base gets attacked by scary giant robots! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ ママと呼ばないで であります / 吉岡平正義 妄想するは我にあり! であります
Keroro, Don`t Call Me Mama / Masayoshi Yoshiokadaira: That Delusion is Mine!
episode.summary: When a newborn baby alien shows up in Keroro`s bed, he takes care of it, even as the baby becomes huge and eats up the year`s invasion budget. Later, after Momoka`s bodyguard Yoshiokadaira loses his confidence on the job, the Keroro Platoon restores it and then some with eyedrops that turn the young man into a delusional megalomaniac. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 武者ケロ・伍の巻 隠し砦ケロン人 でござ候
Musha Kero, Volume 5: Keronian of the Hidden Fortress
episode.summary: Keroro and company infiltrate Musha Viper Goemon`s fortress to find the final legendary weapon, while Dororo duels with fellow ninja (and Koyuki lookalike) Yukino, who stole the first four crystals from the platoon. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 武者ケロ・六の巻 蘇る勇者 でござ候
Musha Kero, Volume 6: The Revived Hero!
episode.summary: The climax of Musha Kero is here, as the Keroro Platoon fights the monster Nanamata-no-Orochi with the five pieces of the ultimate weapon and uncover the secret of what they all do together! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 556と5884! であります
Kogoro and Kobayashi!
episode.summary: 556 finds a cute little critter in a storage unit, and he and Lavie adopt it as a pet named 5884. Meanwhile, Keroro is looking for the oil-eating monster he ordered to use for a Pekoponian invasion... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 映画に行こう!
Keroro, Let`s Go to the Movies!
episode.summary: Keroro experiences the annoyances, and joys, of seeing a movie in a movie theater. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 超人ケロロ であります / ケロロ 黒電話捜査官66 であります
Keroro, The Incredible Keroro / Keroro, Black-Phone Investigator 66
episode.summary: Keroro becomes a hulking super-frog in order to intimidate Natsumi. Later, when Keroro becomes the victim of a phone scam, Kululu creates an analog phone robot to help track down the culprit. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 冬樹 トランクス対ブリーフ / ガルル 密かなる想い!?
Fuyuki, Trunks versus Briefs / Garuru, Obscured Feelings!?
episode.summary: When Fuyuki`s mom accidentally buys him boxers instead of briefs, he finds himself agonizing over which one he`d rather be wearing. Then Galulu shows up, and... it looks like he`s going to confess his feelings to Pururu?! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 恐怖の大暗黒作戦! であります / ケロロ 恐怖の大美白作戦! であります / ケロロ 恐怖の大停止作戦! であります
Keroro, Frightening Darkness Plan!/Keroro, Frightening Whiteness Plan / Keroro, Frightening Time-Stop Plan!
episode.summary: Keroro has devised three similarly diabolical plans to take over Pekopon! There`s no way they`ll backfire, right? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 冬樹&夏美 ケロロ襲来! であります / ケロロ ウッソだよ~ん♪ であります
Fuyuki and Natsumi, Keroro Invasion! / Keroro, That`s a Lie
episode.summary: After years of lying low, the Keroro Platoon finally invade Earth for real! If this is a joke, it`s a really bad one! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 第一話改訂! であります
Keroro, First Encounter Revisited!
episode.summary: On Keron, the Keroro Platoon`s exploits are dramatized into the popular show, "Keroro Platoon War Chronicle," but Keron Army HQ wants the platoon to remake the very first episode of the long-running series. Keroro and company work on a version where they all invade the Hinata house together, but their creative collaboration quickly hits the rocks. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 恐怖のネガティヴシンキング であります / ケロロ 仁義なき焼肉 であります
Keroro, Negative Thinking of Terror / Keroro, Grilled Meat Without Dignity
episode.summary: An invasion plan backfires, leaving Keroro paralyzed by negative feelings... so paralyzed that he can`t do any of his regular chores at the Hinata house. Later, Keroro and company are at a grilled meat restaurant, but when it turns out they`ve only got enough money for one person`s meal, they split it five ways, which sets in motion a test of wills! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 小雪 サクラ大変! であります
Koyuki, Cherry Blossom Trouble!
episode.summary: Koyuki guides Natsumi and the others to her former village in search of cherry blossoms that are still in bloom. They find a bevy of the unexpected, though, from a phantom girl to a ticked-off dragon! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロゼロ ケロロ小隊出発前夜 であります / ケロゼロ ケロロ小隊ファーストミッション であります
Kero Zero, Keroro Platoon`s Departure Last Night / Kero Zero, Keroro Platoon`s First Mission
episode.summary: In this flashback episode, it`s time for the Keroro Platoon to meet for the first time, but Keroro`s gotten himself, Giroro, and Zeroro locked in their old clubhouse! Afterwards, it`s time for the Keroro Platoon`s first mission, with Keroro having forgotten the Kero Ball. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 桃華 席替え大作戦 であります / 556 オレの想い! であります
Momoka, The Big Seat Change Plan / Kogoro, My Feelings!
episode.summary: Momoka is desperate to win the seat next to Fuyuki when the class shuffles seats around. Later, an alien discovers that nothing can erase 556`s feelings for his sister... or his beloved storage units! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: バリリ 愛しの看護長 であります / ケロロ 空を見上げりゃお袋さん であります
Bariri, Loving Chief Medic / Keroro, Looking Up In the Sky, Mother
episode.summary: Bariri`s back, and he`s still in love with Pururu! This makes it particularly awkward, since he`s injured and she`s his nurse. Then Keroro`s mother comes to visit, and he finds her embarrassing. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 夢をかなえるゾウムシ であります / ケロロ がんばれゴミ袋! であります
Keroro, Weevil That Grants Dreams / Keroro, Do Your Best, Trash Bag!
episode.summary: A wish-granting weevil shows up at Keroro`s doorstep and promises to grant his wish if he`ll just fulfill all the conditions. But what could Keroro`s wish be? Then Natsumi falls in love with an adorable pet trash bag Kululu invented. Something so cute can`t possibly be dangerous, right? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 宇宙デジタル怪獣襲来! であります / ケロロ 変身 であります
Keroro, Eliminate the Space Digital Monster! / Keroro, Transform
episode.summary: As television switches from analog to digital, a monster sweeps down upon Earth to take over the minds of anyone using digital devices. Only old-fashioned analog attacks can defeat it! And then, in punishment for keeping so many of his Gundam models in boxes, Keroro gets turned into one himself. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ギロロ リモコンでデート であります / ケロロ プーがいた洞窟 であります
Giroro, Remote-Controlled Date / Keroro, Pu`s Doubts
episode.summary: Natsumi and Saburo are going on a date, and Giroro can`t bear it! He has a remote control that can control Natsumi`s behavior that he confiscated from Keroro... can he keep the self-control to refrain from using it?! Later, Keroro tells Natsumi and Fuyuki about a time his platoon was stranded on an alien planet and raised a pet in order to eat it. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: タママ 目覚めのキッスは僕のもの であります / プルル ばれちゃった秘密?! であります
Tamama, That Wake-Up Kiss is Mine / Pururu, Revealed Secret?!
episode.summary: Tamama gets the disturbing idea into his head that if he kisses Keroro to wake him up, Keroro will be all "lovey-dovey" for him. As Keroro flees in abject horror from Tamama`s grotesque, oversized lips, everybody but Keroro winds up getting the smooch treatment. Afterwards, Mois discovers a wrinkle on Pururu`s face, and she can`t bring herself to say anything. Everyone in the platoon is cringing and trying not to bring it up during their checkups with the nurse. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ エアなんとか大作戦! であります / ケロロ モテる であります
Keroro, Big Air One Way or Another Operation / Keroro, Return to the Motel
episode.summary: Keroro`s latest devious plan to invade Pekopon involves flooding the world with Cybercaps, headgear that lets the wearer experience whatever they wish in the safety of virtual space. Later, Keroro bonds with a clerk at a toy store over Gundam models and they become fast friends. Or are they more than friends? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロゼロ ペコポン人デザイナーカトヤマ・キコ登場 であります
Kero Zero, Enter Pekoponian Mecha Designer Kiko Katoyama
episode.summary: In another prequel tale set on the Keron Army mothership heading to Earth, when Keroro and company pursue a renegade Pekoponian collaborator, they end up stranded on a desolate planet with a nasty creature for company. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 桃華 ホレたハレたの大騒動 であります / ギロロ 夏美からの脱出! であります
Momoka, Big Happy Digging Idea / Giroro, Escape From Natsumi!
episode.summary: When Momoka gets a love potion from Kululu with which to woo Fuyuki, she fails to follow the fine print, causing chaotic declarations of love. Later, space mold takes over Natsumi`s body, and only Keroro can save her by shrinking down and going in deep. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ちびケロVSちび冬樹 であります
Chibi Kero vs. Chibi Fuyuki
episode.summary: The latest invasion plan goes slightly off course when Fuyuki is accidentally hit with a de-aging ray, turning him into the rambunctious little kid he used to be. But he`s in good company, as Keroro, Giroro, and Dororo turn themselves into half-pint sized versions of themselves, too. They all get along until Li`l Fuyuki challenges Li`l Keroro for the position of platoon commander. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: タママ 先輩はつらいよ であります / 夏美 僕たち男の子! であります
Tamama, It`s Hard Being an Upperclassman / Natsumi, We`re All Boys!
episode.summary: The Keroro Platoon`s getting a new member, and Tamama`s excited to be a senpai. But then the new member is... Joriri?! Then Natsumi accidentally gets turned into a boy for a day, and discovers just how awkward that can be. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ウェットルキング対556! / 三大怪人 ペコポン最小の決戦
Wettol King versus Kogoro / Three Weirdos, Smallest Showdown on Pekopon
episode.summary: The Wettle King is back, and he`s dying in the summer heat! He`s fallen for a beautiful girl with antennae who saved him with a wet handkerchief, but who could that girl be? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 仕込みはOK であります / 小雪 対決! 真夏の海岸 であります
Keroro, Training is OK / Koyuki, Confrontation! Midsummer`s Shore
episode.summary: A mysterious boy from space lands in the Hinata household. He has no memory of who he is, but the answer might be surprising. Then the Hinata siblings and the platoon go back to Hicksville Beach for a comedy contest... again... but this time, Dasonu Maso decides to enter! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ小隊 沈黙のケロロ!
Keroro Platoon, Keroro of Silence!
episode.summary: Wilting in the terrible summer heat, Keroro asks for Kululu`s help. Kululu, of course, is happy to oblige, and gets the platoon a tremendous floating island of ice to relax on. But Keroro isn`t content with just relaxing, once he realizes he can have even more... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ ケロン式ゴルフ / ケロロ 走れケロロ
Keroro, Keron-Style Golf / Keroro, Run Keroro
episode.summary: The frogs invite the Hinata siblings to go golfing. Everything seems fine at first -- but something`s strange about the golf course. And why do they keep hearing 556 laughing? After that, they get an exercise machine that`s booby-trapped from Viper, and Keroro has to figure out WHICH Viper in order to save his friends! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 提督殿強襲! であります / ギロロ チャックはそのままで! であります
Keroro, Assault Admiral! / Giroro, Still With This Chuck
episode.summary: Grandma comes to visit, and Kululu changes places with her?! Then Giroro goes out on a date with Keroro`s-mother-in-Natsumi`s-body, while Natsumi-in-Keroro`s-mother`s-body gets dragged off to a hot spring with Keroro`s father. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロ0 宇宙で出前 であります / ケロ0 食べたい方程式 であります
Kero Zero, Space Catering / Kero Zero, Formula for Eating
episode.summary: Back in the past, when the platoon was still on their way to Earth, Keroro ordered take-out despite the fact that it`s forbidden. Hijinks ensue! And then all the members of the platoon are forbidden to use the toilet, with horrifying consequences... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 幽霊ちゃん ビフォーアフター であります / ギロロ 赤い妖精 であります
Ghost Girl, Before-After / Giroro, the Red Fairy
episode.summary: The Ghost Girl doesn`t feel she`s scary enough, so she asks the Keroro Platoon for a makeover. Then Giroro gets mistaken for a handsome Prince Charming when he saves one of Natsumi`s friends from a monster! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: アリサ 初めてのママ!?
Alisa`s First Time as a Mama!?
episode.summary: Alisa comes to visit, and she doesn`t understand why Fuyuki`s upset. Keroro explains that it`s because his mother is busy with work and can`t go on the picnic she`d planned with them. Alisa takes it upon herself to "motivate" the slacker mangaka who`s taking up all her time and terrify the man back on track. Maybe not the best thing for Fuyuki`s mother! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ&夏美 仁義無きスタンプカードであります / ケロロ 悲しみのケロボット であります
Keroro & Natsumi, Stamp Card May Be One`s Duty / Keroro, Sad Kerobot
episode.summary: Keroro and Natsumi battle at the supermarket over redeeming a point card for a prize. Later, Keroro has a lucid dream in which he`s a giant robot that achieves popularity until being overshadowed by newer models. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ セミ小隊 / ケロロ ケーローの日
Keroro, Cicada Platoon / Keroro, Ribbit Day
episode.summary: The Keroro Platoon transforms themselves into cicadas to "bug" Natsumi and Fuyuki, but come up against a competing alien threat to invade the planet. Later, Keroro and company enjoy Kero Day, in which the whole universe but Earth celebrates Keronians. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 桃華 突然炎のごとく / ケロ0 イチジク戦線の思い出
Momoka, Sudden Dance of Flames / Kero Zero, Front Fig not Unusual
episode.summary: This episode has the backstory of how Momoka fell in love with Fuyuki in the first place. Also, how the Keroro Platoon got picked as the Special Advance Team of the invasion of Earth! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 5人の呆れるケロン人 / 冬樹 人間の惑星
Keroro, 5 Shocked Keronians / Fuyuki, Planet of the Humans
episode.summary: Having seen the movie Twelve Angry Men, Keroro is hoping to be the only person on the jury to convince the others that Giroro isn`t guilty. But when everyone unanimously agrees that he isn`t, Keroro switches strategies... to change his verdict to "guilty"! Later on, a dinosaur appears on Earth, only to discover that his species is extinct and has been replaced by humans. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ドロロ さらば小隊
Dororo, Farewell Platoon
episode.summary: When an ambitious Keronian major takes command of Keroro Platoon, the first order of business is kicking Dororo out for his pacifistic ways. Then the major unveils his plan to wipe out all of the continents... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 秋 地球防衛最前線! / 夏美 緊迫! 授業参観
Aki, Earth`s Front Line of Defense / Natsumi, Tension! Parent`s Day
episode.summary: A pair of usurping invaders show up on Earth to take the invasion away from the Keroro Platoon. But they are accidentally foiled by Hinata Aki. Afterwards, Aki can`t make it to Open Day at Natsumi`s school, so Kululu shows up in her stead. He seems to be behaving oddly well, but... surely he must have something up his sleeve?! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ うっかりビチョビチョ大作戦! であります / ケロロ 侵略! 恐怖のソフトグロン であります
Keroro, Careless Saturated Operation! / Keroro, Invasion! Softglon of Terror
episode.summary: When Keroro has Kululu come up with a spray that causes people to spill things carelessly, the roundabout invasion plan works too well, causing problematic spillages for everyone in the platoon, too. Later, Tamama is in the thick of an invasion by parasitic enemy aliens that look like soft serve ice cream. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ カッパ伝説 / ケロロ おかえりなさい
Keroro, Kappa Legend / Keroro, Welcome Back
episode.summary: Keroro is pretending to be a kappa at a village in order to get gifts of starfruit and Gundam models. But what happens when the platoon and Momoka find out that he`s really an imposter when they all go hunting for the kappa? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 夏美 しゃっくり止めて~ / ケロ0 訓練惑星の待ち人
Natsumi, Stop Those Hiccups / Kero Zero, Awaited Person of the Training Planet
episode.summary: When Natsumi has a stubborn case of hiccups, Keroro and company do everything they can to help stop it. Then it`s back in time with Kero Zero. As the Keroro Platoon trains on a supposedly deserted planet, they hear a young woman singing... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ギロロ 戦場の赤い悪魔 / ケロロ そのウソ, ホント?
Giroro, Red Devil of the Battlefield / Keroro, is That Really a Lie?
episode.summary: It`s a documentary with Giroro`s backstory! And then Kululu builds a satellite that makes everyone`s lies come true. The consequences are both useful and terrifying. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ポヨン ポールにミラクル大作戦! / ケロ0 雪は無慈悲な夜の女王
Poyon, Miracle Paul Operation! / Kero Zero, Snow is a Merciless Queen of the Night
episode.summary: Space Officer Poyon comes to Earth for a tete-a-tete with Paul the super-butler, and the Keroro Platoon has to help arrange it, or they`ll all be arrested. Then in a Kero Zero tale, the platoon discovers an unknown planet covered in snow on the way to Earth. They take a shuttle to the surface to determine whether the snow can be melted into potable water, but then they lose all power... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: アリサ&ネブラ 初めての温泉 / ケロロ小隊 奮闘! 酉の市
Alisa & Nevula, First Hot Spring / Keroro Platoon, Struggle! Torinoichi
episode.summary: Alisa and Nevula join the Hinata-Keroro Platoon hot spring outing, but Nevula has separation anxiety when the wooden wall separating the male and female baths keeps him from his "daughter." Later, the Keroro Platoon goes to a festival in Alien Town to buy a rake that will supposedly bring them good luck for the invasion. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 夏美 タンスの秘密 / ケロロ 夢の中に君がいて
Natsumi, Secret of the Dresser / Keroro, You Were in my Dream
episode.summary: Pairs of aliens suddenly start showing up in Natsumi`s bedroom, and they`re especially interested in her bottom drawer... Later, Keroro wakes up into a dream and he`s not alone. Natsumi and his platoon are also there, and they`re trapped with seemingly no way out. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: またまたゲロゲロ30分
Again Gero Gero 30 Minutes
episode.summary: It`s thirteen short stories packed within one episode (yet again)! This time, we find out what Fuyuki`s childhood dream was, where Saburo(?) lives, and whether feng shui really works in an invasion. Also, an all-butler party, and Fuyuki`s forced to stay the night at Momoka`s house! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 吉岡平 親衛隊哀歌(エレジー) / 夏美 クリスマス会大作戦
Yoshiokadaira, Bodyguard Elegy / Natsumi, Christmas Meeting Operation
episode.summary: Yoshiokadaira wants to quit Momoka`s bodyguard! But why? And then Natsumi desperately wants to invite Saburo-senpai to her Christmas party, but she can`t figure out how. Why is she such a chicken?! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 二人が一人ケロロ~ム! / ケロロ 謎の最終兵器
Keroro, The Two of Us Are One Kerororm / Keroro, Mysterious Ultimate Weapon
episode.summary: Keroro tries fusing bodies with all of the other platoon members, but it doesn`t end quite as he expected it to. Then he buys a giant mech for only 135 yen, convinced that it`s the ultimate invasion weapon! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 新年早々ラッキー / ケロロ 今年はケロン年!
Keroro, New Year`s Lucky Haste / Keroro, This Year Is Keron Year!
episode.summary: It`s New Year`s Day and Keroro has hopes of winning Japan`s New Year`s postcard lottery, the space version, or both! Then, Giroro participates in a race held once every millennium to choose a new sign of the Space Zodiac. Keroro goes overboard in a bid to earn "The Year of Keron" and tries to help Giroro from the sidelines by cheating. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ チャンスは一度! / ダンガル 大地に立つ
Keroro, Just One Chance / Dangale Lands
episode.summary: Keroro trains himself to have an iron will by shunning video recording and focusing on the moment... when his favorite TV shows are on. Later, a Dangal snow sculpture comes to life and has one wish, to see the life-sized Dangal statue in Inner-Tokyo, over a hundred miles away! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: モア さよならペコポン / サブロー 謎多き少年
Mois, Goodbye Pekopon / Saburo, The Mysterious Boy
episode.summary: When Mois unleashes Armageddon upon Earth for real, Keroro is obliged to try and stop her, especially since he accidentally encouraged the Great Lord of Terror. Then, there are a lot of mysteries surrounding Saburo, and Fuyuki learns about one of them when he follows Saburo after school... and comes face to face with a number of parallel world Saburos! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ギロロ Gを倒せ! / ギロロ Gの逆襲
Giroro, Take Down G-Force! / Giroro, G-Force`s Counterattack
episode.summary: A horrifying creature euphemistically called a "G" appears in the Hinata house. They must destroy the unspeakable horror before it multiples and spreads its species over the entire property! Even worse, what if the Gs have sentience and can take revenge?! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: オノノ 幻のケロン兵
Onono, Illusionary Keron Soldier
episode.summary: A Keronian from many generations ago wakes up from a long hibernation in his spaceship after crash-landing on Earth. He`s disgusted with the Keroro Platoon for not having invaded yet, but he has a secret weapon in his possession that might make a difference. It might be more dangerous than he realizes, though! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: タママ 西澤家追放? / 桃華 愛と悲しみのチョコケーキ
Tamama, Kicked Out Of The Nishizawa Family? / Momoka, Chocolate Cake of Love and Sadness
ケロロ 我輩は監督ぢゃよ! / ケロロ&冬樹 大都会の小さな冒険
Keroro, I`m A Director! / Keroro & Fuyuki, Small Adventure in a Big City
episode.summary: Keroro takes over the directing of a movie about the platoon, to the disaster of all involved! And then, Keroro finds out about a legendary movie coming back to a theater, and he and Fuyuki go into the city to watch it together. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロ0 故郷はペコポン
Kero Zero, I am From Pekopon
episode.summary: When the Keroro Platoon gets sent back in time to Pekopon, they find out their friend Kiko`s backstory: how she got abducted off Earth, and how she became a mech designer. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ それだけは返してちょーだい!
Keroro, Please Give Only That Back!
episode.summary: When an untimely wind blows Keroro`s hat off of the laundry line, it ends up in the hands of a little girl in the neighborhood. Keroro tries to get it back, which is a major challenge since she can now turn invisible with the anti-barrier, while Keroro is visible to everyone and everything. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ノビビ が来た!
Nobibi Came!
episode.summary: We finally get to meet Nobibi, Katoyama Kiko`s friend from before she met the Keroro Platoon! He`s actually on Earth searching for her, while Fuyuki and Momoka are looking for a meteorite. Whatever became of Kiko? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: しゅごケロ どっきどきパーティー! / ドロロ ドロ郎がくる!
Shugo Kero, Dokki Doki Party! / Dororo, Doro is Coming!
episode.summary: Guardian Spirits come to help Keroro and Dororo! But is it really the kind of help they need? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ & 冬樹 タイムカプセルの夜
Keroro & Fuyuki, Night of the Time Capsule
episode.summary: When Fuyuki and company go with Keroro to school at night to dig up a time capsule that accidentally contains a "super-secret item," a mysterious mist rolls in. As the gang is separated by the mist, they ruminate on what their lives will be like 20 years in the future, when the time capsule is officially slated to be opened. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 第三惑星の悪夢 / ケロロ 夜のケロロ軍曹
Keroro, Nightmare on the Third Planet! / Sergeant Keroro of the Night
episode.summary: Keroro has a nightmare about something interfering with the ultimate invasion. What could it be? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ ヴァイパーを捜せ! であります / ギロロ 天袋の中の戦士 であります
Keroro, Viper Search! / Giroro, Soldier in the Closet
episode.summary: Viper (master of disguise) shows up on Earth, looking to attack Keroro! And so the platoon leader desperately tries to figure out which person in the Hinata household is him. After that, Giroro gets trapped in Natsumi`s upper closet. How will he ever escape without getting noticed?! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 桃華 私は軍曹? であります / ケロロ 宇宙からの侵略者作戦 であります
Momoka, I`m the Sergeant? / Keroro, Invasion Operation from Space
episode.summary: Momoka accidentally switches bodies with... Keroro?! And then Keroro decides that Natsumi and Fuyuki deserve to be reminded, in black-and-white, B-movie terms, that the platoon is made up of alien invaders from outer space. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 楽しい園芸 であります / 冬樹 いつかの影ふみ であります
Keroro, Enjoyable Horticulture / Fuyuki, Shadow Stepping of the Other Days
episode.summary: Havoc is wreaked when a parasitic space flower takes root on Keroro`s head and starts spewing out Keroro clones. Later, Fuyuki has to capture his renegade shadow before he fades out of existence! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 裸の侵略者 であります/夏美&サブロー 昼休みの空 であります
Keroro, Naked Invasion / Natsumi & Saburo, Launch Break of the Skies
episode.summary: Keroro takes inspiration from "The Emperor`s New Clothes" to create a gun that is invisible to idiots! Later, Natsumi and Saburo are the only members of the school`s new Invasion Club, but why are Keroro and the platoon hunting them down during lunch period? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 侵略達成翌日 / 秋 侵略者になる
Keroro, Invasion Achievement in the Next Day / Aki, Becoming An Invader
episode.summary: Keroro`s mother receives a letter from him that wildly exaggerates how close they are to finishing invading, so she shows up on Earth to "help." Then, on Mothers` Day, Aki decides to join the Keroro Platoon and become an invader for the day! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ドロロ 侵略こそ我が使命! / 小雪 のヒ・ミ・ツ....
Dororo, Invasion is My Mission! / Koyuki`s Se-cre-t
episode.summary: Something strange has happened to Dororo: he seems to have turned back into the scary Assassin he used to be! Later, Koyuki seems to have a scary secret. Her friends all gather together to spy on her and figure out what it is! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: クルル 侵略は始じまっている / ケロロ ケロいい話!
Kururu, the Invasion Has Started / Keroro, a Good Kero Story!
episode.summary: The Keroro Platoon has the horrifying realization that it`s Kululu`s turn to come up with an invasion. They have to stop him, at all costs! And then Keroro comes up with the idea to ply Fuyuki with feel-good stories until he is moved to return the Kero Ball to them. The stories don`t quite have the effect they anticipated. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: タママ お菓子の王国 / 桃華 お世話になります
Tamama, Kingdom of Sweets / Momoka, I Appreciate Your Kindness
episode.summary: Tamama`s invasion plan is to turn everything in the world into sweets. But then it puts Momocchi in danger! Then the Nishizawa Group actually goes bankrupt, leaving Momoka to stay with Fuyuki for awhile. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ギロロ ペコポン侵略開始! / ギロロ&夏美 携帯メール作戦
Giroro, Pekopon Invasion Starts / Giroro & Natsumi, Operation Cell Phone Mail
episode.summary: When Keroro hits on a new way to slack off, Giroro gets to take command of the invasion plans for a day. He orders an expensive, powerful weapon but isn`t thrilled when it goes haywire and tries to vaporize Natsumi. Later, Giroro takes the lead in another strategy, sending phone texts to Natsumi and then leaving her in anxious suspense by suddenly cutting her off. Except it doesn`t quite play out that way... Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 古きに学べ であります / 夏美 優しさは罪 であります
Keroro, Learning with the Old / Natsumi, Gentleness is a Sin...
Keroro Furuki ni Manabe de Arimasu
episode.summary: Keroro decides older things are better, and turns everyone`s stuff into old-fashioned versions! (Dororo sobs because he`s unaffected.) Later on, Natsumi is being suspiciously nice to Keroro. What possible reason could there be?! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 夏美 憧れの侵略者! であります / プルル 六月の花嫁!? であります
Natsumi: A Yearning Invader! / Pururu, June`s Bride?
Natsumi Akogare no Shinryakusha de Arimasu
episode.summary: The frogs decide to try becoming super-hot humanoid men in order to tempt Natsumi to consent to their invading. It almost works. Later, Bariri shows up yet again in order to try to convince Pururu to marry him. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: モア 天才ハッカー? であります / クルル 小さな古時計 であります
Mois, Genius Hacker? / Kururu, Small Old Clock
Moa Tensai Hacker? de Arimasu
episode.summary: An alien virus jumps from Mois`s laptop to the underground base`s mainframe and then really wreaks havoc! Then a sentient antique clock from space arrives for Keroro. To help the kindly clock regain its memories, Kululu participates in a tense black market auction. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ドロロ 仮面の男 であります / モア 黒い来訪者 であります
Dororo, the Man of the Mask / Mois, Black Visitor
Dororo Kamen no Otoko de Arimasu
episode.summary: Keroro and company do everything they can to get the masked Dororo to show his mouth, a sight they`ve never seen before. Later, Mois`s pen pal from space visits her on Earth and intends to carry out an old promise to help her friend destroy the planet. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ギロロ 脱出不可能?! であります / ケロロ 救出不可能?! であります
Giroro, Impossible Escape?! / Keroro, Impossible Rescue?!
episode.summary: Giroro`s test flight of a new spaceship has run into a terrible danger, and he`s afraid he`ll never make it back safely again. Worse, Natsumi`s towel apparently slipped, and his video feed wasn`t on to see it! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 宇宙お留守番長降臨 であります / 夏美 戦場カメラマン大訓練! であります
Keroro, Advent of the Space Chief of House-Sitting / Natsumi, Cameraman Training Battlefield!
episode.summary: When Keroro`s left home, he appreciates it at first, but then finds that having the run of the Hinata house isn`t all it`s cracked up to be. Later, when Natsumi borrows a Kero Ball to use as a video camera for a contest, she soon finds herself in the middle of a dangerous combat cameraman training simulation... inside the ball itself. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 夏美 怒ってはいけない一週間 であります / ケロロ 侵略はベツバラ? であります
Natsumi, One Week Without Anger / Keroro, Invasion is a Second Stomach?
episode.summary: Keroro hatches a plan to convert Natsumi`s anger into energy for the invasion... or is it just an excuse for him to slack off? Then, a misunderstanding over the expression "dessert stomach" leads the platoon to take desperate measures to get their own version of this "secret weapon." Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 桃華 普通にしやがれ! であります / ポール の休日 であります
Momoka, Becoming Normal / Paul`s Day Off
episode.summary: Momoka decides to try to be normal... but she has no idea what that is! And then Paul takes a day off, and starts doing some really suspicious things. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 正義の味方! であります / ケロロ あっという間の侵略! であります
Keroro, Super Hero! / Keroro, Invasion in a Blink!
episode.summary: After Keroro is mistaken for a superhero, he lives up to the misconception, becoming the neighborhood do-gooder... until his heroism clashes with an invading flying tank that Keroro designed himself! Later, another invasion plan goes awry, trapping the Keroro Platoon in a state of frozen time. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ, バージョンアップモデル であります / ケロロ お化粧するは我にあり であります
Keroro, Version Up Model / Keroro, the Make Up Used is the Self
episode.summary: The Keroro Platoon doesn`t seem to be noticeable enough to the Hinatas -- so they paint themselves in crazy Gundam model colors in order to become more noticeable. Then Keroro has an invasion plan that involves turning human makeup crazy! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 夏美 押すな! であります / ケロロ 侵略者度チェック であります
Natsumi, Presses It! / Keroro, Invader Level Check
episode.summary: Natsumi finds herself plagued with a plethora of "Do Not Push" buttons. How long can she hold out before pushing one of them? Later, the Keroro Platoon enters the Kero Ball in order to rescue Natsumi and Fuyuki from a mind-boggling invader level check quiz. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ちびケロ あの夏の花火 であります / ケロロ 水着美女コンテスト! であります
Chibi Kero, Fireworks from the Summer / Keroro, Swimsuit Beauties Contest!
episode.summary: The platoon recalls a time back on Keron when they had to sneak Zeroro out of his house so they could all see fireworks together. Later, the Hinata siblings, the Keroro Platoon, and friends return once again to Hicksville Beach, where a new nighttime swimsuit beauty contest is going to be held, and Natsumi (with a temporary adult body) is yet again participating! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 小雪 ハロウィンの日 であります / 小雪VSアリサ 深海の決闘 であります
Koyuki, Day of Halloween / Koyuki vs Alisa, Duel of the Ocean Depths
episode.summary: Koyuki makes a new friend on Halloween... one of those who lurk in the dark, who Alisa is hunting as her latest prey! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 556 史上最凶の相棒 であります / 小雪 初めてのカレー であります
556, Unluckiest Partner / Koyuki, First Curry
episode.summary: Natsumi asks Giroro to house-sit while she`s out, but then he winds up having to house-sit with 556, the worst house-sitting partner ever! Later, Koyuki convinces Kululu to teach her how to make curry, to his horror. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 冬樹 気になる! であります / 夏美 海は広いな大きいな であります
Fuyuki Worried! / Natsumi, the Ocean Isn`t Large or Big
episode.summary: Fuyuki`s having dinner with Momoka`s father, and he notices the man has an extremely long nose hair. He doesn`t know how to mention it without making the man angry! And then they all go to Hisquesviel Planet, and Natsumi loses the top of her swimsuit. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 冬樹 蝶人出現? であります / ギロロ 招かれざる客 であります
Fuyuki, Butterfly Person Appears? / Giroro, Uninvited Guest
episode.summary: Fuyuki`s excited when they find a Mothman-like creature in the forest. Then, an uninvited "guest" appears: a deserter from the Keron Army! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 桃華 星空の気持ち であります / ケロロ 福毛ちゃん であります
Momoka, Mood of the Starry Sky / Keroro, Little Hair of Luck
episode.summary: When Momoka invites Fuyuki to an abandoned planetarium, he becomes possessed by the spirit of an old projector! Then, Keroro has a single wild hair growing on top of his head, which he cultivates after Fuyuki tells him it`s a "lucky hair." Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 激突☆暴輪具(スタアボウリング)大会 であります / ケロロ 我輩, 超決断計画!? であります
Keroro, Clash, Star Circular Violence Tool Tournament / Keroro, My Super Decisive Plan!?
episode.summary: Saburo and Keroro bet the Earth on whether the human or the frog team can win a bowling match! And then Keroro`s dismayed by his platoon`s lack of enthusiasm about the regular invasion meeting, so he turns into a giant monster to go on a rampage. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 隊長代理ロボ出動! であります / ケロロ 月は豪華だ! であります
Keroro, Leader Representative Robot Launches! / Keroro, the Moon is Luxurious
episode.summary: Wanting to come up with a brilliant invasion plan without interruptions, Keroro uses a cheap, discount copy robot to take his place! Later, he and the platoon fulfill the rash promise made by that robot to take the Hinata family up to the moon. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ドロロ 忍び寄る影 であります / 夏美 日向家建物探訪 であります
Dororo, Ninja Approaching the Shadow / Natsumi, Exploration of the Construction of the Hinata Residence
episode.summary: Zolulu, the assassin who considers himself Dororo`s arch-enemy, traps the rest of the Keroro Platoon so they can`t interfere as he engages Dororo in a duel to the death. Then Keroro tricks Natsumi into letting him "borrow" the house for a day. It`s for a TV show and involves the platoon making some renovations, which Natsumi doesn`t mind, until she learns the hard way that they`re of the "home defense" kind! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ アルジャナイノンに花束を であります / ギロロ Oh! モウギュウ であります
Keroro, Flowers for Algernainon / Giroro, Oh! Ferocious Ox
episode.summary: Super-intelligent mice have invaded the house! And then, Keroro tries transforming Giroro into a cow as part of an invasion operation. But Giroro being male, he turns into a {\i0}bull{\i1}... a terrifying minotaur-like creature, to be exact. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 556 宇宙刑事だっ! であります / ラビー におまかせ であります
556, Space Sheriff / Lavie, Leave it to Me
episode.summary: 556 can hardly wait to pass the exam to become a space sheriff! But he`s not doing so well with the practice tests. Later, the platoon gets captured by Viper, leaving Lavie to rescue them! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 誕生! 新必殺技! であります / 夏美 ツツヌケ であります
Keroro, Birth! New Final Technique! / Natsumi Going Through
episode.summary: Keroro works hard to develop a new special move to help him defeat Natsumi. And then, he uses Keron-style ventriloquism to make her think she can read minds! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ トイレでサバイバル! であります / ケロロ 対ギロロ対タママ対ドロロ であります
Keroro, Restroom Survival / Keroro vs Giroro vs Tamama vs Dororo
episode.summary: Special toilet-centric episode! Chased by Natsumi, Keroro holes up in the bathroom and tries to survive with whatever is on hand. Later, Keroro and company are in town when they`re struck by the need to relieve themselves all at the same time, but can`t seem to find an available toilet. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 秋本当のラーメン であります / ジョリリ 偽りのラーメン であります
Aki, Real Ramen / Joriri, False Ramen
episode.summary: The Keroro Platoon opens a ramen shop, selling all kinds of strange and creative ramen, such as one made with Gundam-shaped noodles. But Aki convinces them to go with flavor over originality. Later, Joriri shows up and gives them all kinds of advice that is his usual style of indecipherable. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 恐怖の赤信号 であります / ケロロ 侵略プラスマイナスであります
Keroro, Red Light of Fear / Keroro, Invasion Plus Minus
episode.summary: Keroro and the platoon torment the Hinata siblings with stoplights planted throughout the house. Later, Keroro is addicted to an invasion simulation video game that may show him how to do it in real life. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 日向家 春,帰還 であります
Hinata Family, Haru Returns
episode.summary: Aki mentions on the phone that "haru" is coming, and Keroro immediately assumes that it must be a person, not "haru" as in the season of "spring." Then there`s a huge snafu with the Keron Army inviting the friends of the Keroro Platoon to come visit Keron... with some ulterior motive. Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ小隊 真ドラゴンウォリアーズ であります / モア もうひとりへの春 であります
Keroro Platoon, Real Dragon Warriors / Mois, That One Other Person`s Spring
episode.summary: To save Planet Keron from a super-powerful cosmic enemy, the frogs of the Keron Platoon metamorphose into dragons! Then, Mois helps her doppelgänger Asami to study for her last university entrance exam! Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 桜華 引退! であります / ケロロ 君は生き残ることができるか であります
Ouka Resigns / Keroro Must Survive
episode.summary: Ouka Nishizawa decides to retire to be more of a mother to Momoka. But is that what she really wants, deep down? Fuyuki joins the Keroro Platoon on a rescue mission to Area 51! Can they all avoid setting off the sneaky death flags? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: ケロロ 未来からの訪問者 であります / 623 ラジオスターの悲劇 であります
Keroro, Visitor from the Future / 623, Tragedy of the Radio Star
episode.summary: A robot comes from the future to help Keroro be less of a screw-up... but not in the way you`d expect. It`s 623`s final radio show, and Natsumi`s invited! Can she resist the urge to shatter the mystery? Source: crunchyroll

episode.title: 幽霊ちゃん 私 成仏します であります / ギロロ 夢見る頃を過ぎても であります
Spirit-chan, I`ll Rest in Peace / Giroro, Even After Dreaming Time
episode.summary: Sad that no one notices her, the Ghost Girl has decided to move on. And then, the platoon put Giroro to sleep and gives him dreams about Natsumi so that he won`t notice the real her is in trouble from the platoon! Source: crunchyroll
